abstract: Forward and backward Brillouin scattering spectra are measured for a holey fiber in the 1525-1585 nm wavelength region. Experiments suggest that the existence of air-holes reduces the shear acoustic-velocity with respect to the torsional/radial TR/sub 2m/-modes.

articleTitle: OFC - Fiber gratings
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: All-fiber resonators are created by superimposing wideband chirped gratings. We discuss the properties of multichannel devices based on this technology using single cavity and coupled-cavity designs, including applications to multi-wavelength fiber lasers and tunable dispersion compensation.

articleTitle: Quantum key distribution the science of secret communications
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.

articleTitle: III-nitride-based planar lightwave circuits for optical communications
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Planar lightwave circuits based on III-nitride wide-bandgap semiconductors is proposed and demonstrated for the first time. The feasibility of developing III-nitride-based photonic integrated circuits for applications in 1550 nm fiber-optic communications is discussed.

articleTitle: Dynamic gain-fluctuations in gain-clamped EDFA in packet switched optical transmissions
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: A ring laser gain-clamped erbium-doped fiber amplifier (EDFA) was used to study dynamic gain fluctuations induced by laser relaxation oscillations during optical packet collisions in an emulated packet switched WDM network.

articleTitle: Impact of fiber aging and cable repair in an installed 28-nm transatlantic 96 x 10 Gb/s DWDM system
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Using the 28-nm bandwidth, transatlantic segment of the Tyco Global Network<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">reg</sup>, we present the first report of the impact of fiber aging and cable repairs on gain shape and performance of an installed transoceanic DWDM system

articleTitle: Efficient estimation of outage probability for PMD mitigation by electronic equalization
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: The outage probability for adaptive threshold, feed forward/decision feedback and MLSE type receivers is determined using a simplified model for the penalty dependence on relative launch SOP and PMD.

articleTitle: Investigation of the distribution of the states of polarization on the poincare' sphere using the spherical radial distribution function
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: A new method for characterization of the distribution of the states of polarization on the Poincare sphere is described. Analysis of the state of polarization distribution is based on spherical radial distribution function

articleTitle: Passively mode-locked 10-GHz 1.3-/spl mu/m Nd:vanadate laser for RZ pulse generation
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We demonstrate a diode-pumped, passively mode-locked Nd:YVO/sub 4/ (vanadate) laser with a repetition rate of 10 GHz emitting at 1.34 /spl mu/m. Passive mode locking was achieved by using a novel GaInNAs based saturable absorber mirror.

articleTitle: Effects of dispersion, PMD, and PDL on the intensity noise suppression of spectrum-sliced incoherent light sources using semiconductor optical amplifiers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We show, through experiment, that the intensity noise suppression of spectrum-sliced incoherent light sources achieved by using gain-saturated semiconductor optical amplifiers can be negated by chromatic dispersion, polarization-mode dispersion, or polarization-dependent loss.

articleTitle: Trade-off of dispersion slope and effective area in ultra low slope NZ-DSF for non-dispersion-compensated WDM metro transmission
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We investigate the nonlinear penalty of ultra-low-slope NZ-DSF with less than 50-/spl mu/m/sup 2/ effective area in nondispersion-compensated systems. For 80and 155-km, 10-Gbit/s transmission, negligible nonlinear penalty was found for launch powers up to 0 dBm/ch.

articleTitle: Reciprocating optical modulator using a resonant modulating electrode for generation of high-order double sideband components
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a reciprocating optical modulator having a phase-shifted fiber Bragg grating, a tunable fiber Bragg grating, and a resonant-type optical modulator. It enables effective generation of high-order double sideband components.

articleTitle: Net coding gain of 10.2 dB using an irregular LDPC code with a three-dimensional analyser [optical communication applications]
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We present a three-dimensional decoding scheme for an irregular low density parity check code (LDPC). With this setup, we achieved a net coding gain of 10.2 dB and a significant improvement in the iterating decoding process.

articleTitle: A low-dark-current InGaAs photodetector made on metamorphic InGaP buffered GaAs substrate
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: A novel top-illuminated In/sub 0.53/Ga/sub 0.47/As p-i-n photodiode grown on linearly graded metamorphic In/sub x/Ga/sub 1-x/P (0.51<x<1) buffered GaAs substrate is demonstrated with dark current, responsivity, noise-equipment power, and bandwidth of 13 pA, 0.77 A/W, 6.9/spl times/10/sup -11/ W/Hz/sup 0.5/, and 7.5 GHz, respectively.

articleTitle: Impact of systematic external birefringence on PMD
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: By simulation it is shown that fibers with a small intrinsic polarization mode dispersion (PMD) may be compromised more than those with large PMD when subject to a source of deterministic extrinsic birefringence, e.g. stress.

articleTitle: All-monolithic InAlGaAs/InP VCSELs for 1.3 /spl sim/ 1.5 /spl mu/m wavelength ranges
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: All-monolithic InAlGaAs/InP VCSELs over 1.3/spl sim/1.5 /spl mu/m wavebands were successfully demonstrated. A single mode power of /spl sim/1 mW and modulation bandwidth exceeding 2.5 Gbps at room temperature and CW operation over 80/spl deg/C were obtained in both 1.3 and 1.5 /spl mu/m.

articleTitle: Responses of optical amplifier to optical bursts
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Responses of an optical amplifier to optical bursts with different type and different frequency are studied. Amplifier behaviours in constant gain, constant power and constant current operation modes are compared with each other.

articleTitle: Full-duplex wireless-over-fibre transmission incorporating a CWDM ring architecture with remote millimetre-wave LO delivery using a bi-directional SOA
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We demonstrate the first full-duplex wireless-over-fibre transmission between a central station and a CWDM ring architecture with remote 40 GHz LO delivery using a bi-directional semiconductor optical amplifier.

articleTitle: Performance evaluation of single-section and three-section PMD compensators using extended Monte Carlo methods
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We evaluate the performance of single-section and three-section PMD compensators. Three-section compensators offer less than twice the advantage of single-section compensators (in dB) due to higher-order PMD correlations.

articleTitle: Polarization-insensitive 40-Gb/s wavelength converter using cross-phase modulation in twisted fiber and optical filtering
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We demonstrate all-optical wavelength conversion with 0.3-dB polarization-sensitivity, using cross-phase modulation in a twisted fiber and optical filtering. Error-free operation with only 1-dB penalty is realized at 40 Gbit/s with the input signal polarization scrambled.

articleTitle: Fabrication of strong re-writable long-period fiber gratings with a CO/sub 2/ laser
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We show that the sensitivity of boron-doped fibers to CO/sub 2/ radiation can be enhanced by a uniform pre-exposure. Resulting gratings could be erased with a similar uniform exposure and recorded again with no loss of fiber sensitivity.

articleTitle: Next generation fiber manufacturing for the highest performing conventional single mode fiber
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: A low-cost, large preform (>5000 fiber km) manufacturing process for the highest performing conventional single-mode fiber is described. Key manufacturing steps and fiber performance parameters are highlighted.

articleTitle: Evaluation of optical amplifier robustness against covert QoS attacks in a point-to-point DWDM link
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: This paper presents three covert QoS attacking scenarios in a DWDM link. The robustness of optical amplifiers against these attacks is evaluated based on their incorporated gain-clamping and power-equalization functionalities.

articleTitle: Amplitude and timing jitter reduction using a fiber NOLM incorporating a fiber Bragg grating based pulse shaper
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We demonstrate the simultaneous removal of amplitude and timing jitter from an RZ data-stream using a superstructured fiber grating pulse shape converter and subsequent gating of a clean optical clock in a NOLM.

articleTitle: Quadrature-mixer based receiver for improved measurement of the optical phase transfer function
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: An RF quadrature-mixer based receiver is used to increase the bandwidth of the stimulus in measuring the optical phase transfer function. The technique is demonstrated for stimuli in the range of 1 kHz to 10 MHz.

articleTitle: All-optical incoherent negative-tap microwave filter using the phase inversion of a single electro-optic modulator
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: A novel all-optical negative-tap microwave filter based on multiple optical carriers and a dispersive medium is demonstrated. Using the /spl pi/-phase inversion in a single electro-optic modulator and the modulator V/sub /spl pi// dependence with wavelength, negative coefficients are obtained.

articleTitle: OFI - PONs
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We propose and demonstrate the feasibility of a lOOh reach, remotely-seeded DWDM SuperPON employing a colorless, monolithically-integrated, SOA-EAM modulator to provide upstream customer data channels operating at 2.5Gbit.k or 10GbiVs

articleTitle: Wavelength independent vertically-coupled polymer optical waveguide switch
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We propose a composite polymer vertically-coupled optical waveguide switch that offers wavelength independent switching characteristics. The variation of the extinction ratio within the C-band is less than 4 dB for bar state and 1 dB for cross state.

articleTitle: Fabrication of multi-channel polymeric PLC-type variable optical attenuator by UV embossing
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Polymeric PLC-type thermo-optic variable optical attenuator was fabricated without residual slab waveguide by UV imprinting. Polymeric VOA showed 30 dB attenuation with 80 mW input power at 1.55 /spl mu/m. The rise and fall times are less than 5 msec.

articleTitle: OFN - 40 Gb/s transmission
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We report the first field transmission experiment using the APRZ modulation format for 40-Gbls transmission through 540 km SSMF, which confirms the improved nonlinear tolerance of APE. The optimum phase-modulation amplitude in this experiment is π/2. (c)Z005 Optical Society of America

articleTitle: 40 Gb/s-based WDM 4,300 km straight line transmission and comparison of re-circulating loop line
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Direct performance comparison between the straight line and re-circulating fiber-loop configurations was described in terms of mean Q and Q variance through 42.8 Gb/s/spl times/32 WDM transmission over 4,300 km.

articleTitle: Semi-analytic gain control algorithm for the fiber Raman amplifier under dynamic channel reconfiguration
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: A semi-analytic gain-clamping algorithm for the deeply saturated, multi-pump fiber Raman amplifier (FRA) is proposed. Utilizing parameters from the steady state conditions, the gain excursion below 0.5 dB (up to 78/80 channel drop, +5 dBm/channel) can be achieved within milliseconds time scale.

articleTitle: Experimental analysis of scaling property of out-of-band control plane traffic for IP/photonic GMPLS networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: The traffic of GMPLS control messages was experimentally analyzed using actual GMPLS nodes in order to design a GMPLS out-of-band control plane. The traffic is affected by a change in local topology rather than the entire network scale or delay.

articleTitle: Investigation of the tolerance of wavelength-routed optical networks to inaccuracy in traffic load forecasts
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We carried out extensive computer simulations of wavelength-routed optical networks, identifying features of network topology that allow high tolerance to traffic forecast inaccuracy. The findings can be used to simplify the network design process.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of waveguides in arrayed-rod photonic crystals for integrated optical buffers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: New arrayed-rod photonic-crystal (PC) waveguides suitable for micro optical buffers were fabricated. It is suggested that waveguides integrated in this PC can delay light with a wide range of wavelengths for several tens of nanoseconds.

articleTitle: Novel fabrication method of polymer PLC platforms with V-grooves for passive alignment
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Using a dry film resist, a novel method for fabrication of polymer PLC platforms with V-grooves is developed for passive alignment of optical fibers to polymer waveguides. This technique provides a simple and cost-effective fabrication method of polymer PLCs.

articleTitle: A design method for bending-insensitive single-mode holey fibers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We propose a novel design method for bending-insensitive single-mode holey fibers with a mode field diameter of 9 /spl mu/m, a small allowable bending radius of 6.4 mm, and a cutoff wavelength of 1.24 /spl mu/m.

articleTitle: Polarization insensitive four-wave mixing assisted by Raman amplification: influence of Raman-induced Kerr effect
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: The polarization degree of the two wavelengths involved in FWM can be decreased in the resonant spectra of stimulated Raman scattering, leading to polarization insensitive FWM being observed by using a continuous wave pump source.

articleTitle: Erbium-doped waveguide amplifier insensitive to channel transient for reconfigurable high-capacity WDM metro networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We demonstrate an optical-gain clamped EDWA suitable for application to high-capacity reconfigurable WDM metro-networks. The EDWA is insensitive to channel add/drop or pump fluctuations. We also show no spectral-hole-burning offset, reconfigurable gain and no noise-figure degradation.

articleTitle: 10,200 km 22/spl times/2/spl times/10 Gbit/s RZ-DQPSK dense WDM transmission without inline dispersion compensation through optical phase conjugation
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Using optical phase conjugation with a polarization independent periodically-poled lithium-niobate subsystem, we demonstrate dense WDM 2/spl times/10 Gbit/s RZ-DQPSK transmission over 10,200 km of SSMF with a record accumulated dispersion exceeding 80,000 ps/nm.

articleTitle: Polymeric optical interconnect for chip-to-chip communication
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: An optical interconnect has been produced on FR-4 board. The interconnect consists of photo-defined optical layers coupled to VCSELs and photodetectors via out of plane mirrors. Materials, fabrication methods and test results will be discussed.

articleTitle: Distributed fiber optic intrusion sensor system
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: The first field tests of a system for detecting and locating intruders walking above or near a buried cable containing a single mode telecommunications fiber as the sensing element are reported.

articleTitle: Complete time and frequency-dependent modeling of electro-absorption modulators
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We present a wideband model for optical modulators, which simultaneously accounts for time- and wavelength-dependent effects. We validate static and dynamic modeling using real world measurements of modulators having usually an especially complex behavior.

articleTitle: Traffic grooming for WDM rings using optical burst transport
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: For WDM rings, we propose a sub-lambda traffic grooming scheme, which we term optical burst transport (OBT). To demonstrate its scalability and performance, we investigate the operational issues, and discuss an OBT prototype implementation.

articleTitle: Field demonstration of 160-Gb/s OTDM signal using eight 20-Gb/s 2-bit/symbol channels over 200 km
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We demonstrated transmission of 160-Gbit/s OTDM signals comprising eight 20-Gbit/s 2-bit/symbol ASK-DPSK tributary channels over 200 km of installed fiber to investigate the effect of bandwidth compression on transmission impairment due to polarization mode dispersion.

articleTitle: Fast and precise wavelength switching of an SG-DBR laser for 1.07-b/s/Hz DVMM systems
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Fast (<100-/spl mu/s) and precise (/spl plusmn/2-GHz) wavelength switching of an SG-DBR laser with fast feedback frequency control is confirmed by using 1.07-bit/s/Hz DWDM of 40-Gb/s pre-filtered inverse-RZ signals.

articleTitle: Quantum generated one-time-pad encryption with 1.25 Gbps clock synchronization
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Clock recovery techniques at 1.25 Gbit/s enable quantum key distribution at sifted-key rates greater than 3.5 Mbit/s. Our system incorporates expeditious forward error correction algorithms, and is designed for practical implementation of the one-time-pad cipher.

articleTitle: PMD tolerance of 8/spl times/170 Gbit/s field transmission experiment over 430 km SSMF with and without PMDC
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We report on the impact of PMD in a 8/spl times/170 Gbit/s DWDM transmission experiment over 430 km field installed SSMF with and without PMD compensation. Stable performance is only achieved when using PMDC.

articleTitle: Optical channel performance monitoring using coherent detection
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We demonstrate a multi-functional optical system performance monitor using coherent heterodyne detection. In addition to performing high-resolution optical spectrum analyzing, the system is capable of monitoring chromatic dispersion and PMD at each wavelength channel.

articleTitle: Return-loss-suppressed electroabsorption modulator with novel transmission line electrodes on conductive substrate
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: An electroabsorption modulator with transmission line electrodes on an n-InP substrate has been newly designed and fabricated. We demonstrate clear eye opening at 40 Gbit/s with well-suppressed electrical return loss of less than -20 dB.

articleTitle: Investigation of cross phase modulation (XPM) effect on amplitude- and phase-modulated multi-level signals in dense-WDM transmission
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: The XPM effect on optical 8-ary APSK (amplitude- and phase-shift keying) multi-level signals is experimentally investigated, for the first time. Its feasibility is demonstrated in 0.48 Tbit/s (30 Gbit/s/ch) 50-GHz-spaced 16-channel dense-WDM 160-km unrepeatered transmission.

articleTitle: 170 Gbit/s single-polarization transmission over 650 km SSMF with 130 km spans using RZ-DPSK
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We report on single-polarization 170 Gbit/s transmission over 650 km SSMF using the RZ-DPSK modulation format with base rate 42.6 Gbit/s, with hybrid EDFA/Raman amplification in all five 130 km spans and with error-free transmission without FEC in all tributaries.

articleTitle: Optical packet power equalization with large dynamic range using controlled gain-clamped SOA
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We demonstrate a technique to equalize power variation between packets and bursts using controlled gain-clamped SOA. We equalize incoming packets with 10-dB power differences and remove SOA-induced waveform distortion. We achieve >4-dB sensitivity improvement.

articleTitle: Investigation of spun fibers using high resolution reflectometry
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Bi- and uni-directionally spun fibers are experimentally investigated with high-resolution reflectometric methods. Polarization beat-patterns reflecting both the strongly reduced global birefringence and the spin period can be extracted in agreement with theory.

articleTitle: Automatic control of optical equalizers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Optical equalizers for an adaptive compensation of varying distortions in high-bitrate optical transmission systems are currently of high interest. We review strategies for an automatic control of optical equalizers.

articleTitle: Compensation of chromatic dispersion by chirp control in all-optical regenerator based on asymmetric Sagnac loop
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We describe the compensation of chromatic dispersion by control of the chirp in an all-optical regenerator, based on SOA in an asymmetric Sagnac loop. We demonstrate the transmission of a 10 Gbit/s NRZ signal up to 200 km.

articleTitle: Tunable dispersion compensator with integrated wavelength locking
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We demonstrate a compact and simple silica-waveguide 10-Gb/s dispersion compensator that works with uncontrolled wavelength transmitters by tracking the signal wavelength. 10.7-Gb/s transmissions over 5100ps/nm with duobinary and 3825ps/nm with unchirped NRZ are shown.

articleTitle: Link performance of all-optical buffers using slow light
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We analyze the link performance of an optical buffer using slow light as the delay mechanism. A power penalty of a few dBm is found for a 40 Gbit/s link. We show the existence of a bandwidth-storage product trade-off.

articleTitle: Enabling 160-Gbit/s transmitter and receiver designs
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: The field of ultra high-speed (/spl ges/160 Gb/s) transmission has developed rapidly over the past years from proof-of-principle demonstrations towards advanced field trial applications. We review recent trends in 160 Gb/s signal generation and detection techniques.

articleTitle: Tapered fiber bundles for high power applications
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: A method of brightness enhancement for fiber combiners is discussed. The enabling condition is low launched-mode fraction of the input fiber modal capacity. Fiber bundle preparation methods for end-pumping as well as cladding-pumping are described.

articleTitle: Achieving open access in Ethernet PON (EPON)
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: "Open access" is a regulatory requirement in many countries mandating that the residential access network infrastructure be competitively available to service providers. We propose dual service-level agreements (SLAs) to enforce fairness in open access EPON.

articleTitle: Quality of service support over SUCCESS-DWA: a highly evolutional and cost-effective optical access network
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We investigate the scheduling algorithms with quality of service support for a novel optical access network, the SUCCESS-DWA PON. Results show that the high-priority traffic exhibits good packet delay performance in the proposed scheduling algorithm.

articleTitle: 160-GHz pulse generator using a 40-GHz phase modulator and PM fiber
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We demonstrate chirp-free CS-RZ pulse generation with a repetition rate of 160 GHz using a phase modulator driven by a 40 GHz clock and two low-cost polarization-maintaining fibers. The unwanted low frequency tones are suppressed by more than 15 dB.

articleTitle: 10 Gb/s photocurrent driven, widely tunable electroaborption modulator based wavelength converter
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: An electroabsorption modulator based photocurrent driven wavelength converter has been fabricated and characterized. Bit error rate measurements at 10 Gb/s show less than 2.5 dB power penalty over 30 nm with 10 dB extinction and input fiber-coupled power less than 2 mW

articleTitle: A novel admission control system for bandwidth on demand Ethernet services over optical transport networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: A novel scheme used in conjunction with the multiple spanning trees protocol to control an Ethernet virtual connection admission into a service provider optical network with the most efficient path selection through the Ethernet layer-2 network.

articleTitle: Fiber-based all-optical 2R regeneration of multiple WDM channels
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We propose a WDM-capable 2R regenerator employing a combination of off-center filtering of SPM-broadened spectra and inter-channel-nonlinearity-suppressing dispersion map enabled by periodic group-delay devices. Our numerical simulations demonstrate 1.5-dB eye-opening improvement by this regenerator.

articleTitle: PMD monitoring by spectral SOP rotation using a real-time optical Fourier transformer
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Experimental demonstration of a non-invasive spectral polarimeter (SOP spectral evolution monitored in 1.9 ps Gaussian-RZ pulses). DGD is derived from SOP spectral rotation rate. Real-time optical Fourier transform is used to map SOP traces from spectrum-to-time.

articleTitle: Study of polarization driven Q fluctuations on deployed undersea fiber systems
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We use a simple model to analyze the polarization driven performance fluctuations in an optical transmission system. The model shows good agreement with data accumulated over a long period of time on deployed systems.

articleTitle: -29dBm sensitivity, InAlAs APD-based receiver for 10Gb/s long-haul (LR-2) applications
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We present an avalanche photodiode (APD)-based receiver for 10 Gbit/s applications that achieves record-setting sensitivity of -29 dBm, and is based on a new, planar, InAlAs APD that is Telcordia qualified.

articleTitle: Optimal design of sub-wavelength dielectric gratings as broad band mirrors
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We have developed an efficient and rigorous design tool for optimal design of broad band mirrors (BBMs) based on sub-wavelength dielectric gratings. Various grating BBMs for TM, TE and both polarizations have been designed.

articleTitle: Packet error rate and bit error rate non-deterministic relationship in optical network applications
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: The non-deterministic relationship between bit error rate and packet error rate is demonstrated for an optical media access layer in common use. We show that frequency components of coded, non-random data can cause this relationship.

articleTitle: Experimental study of photocurrent imbalance in a 42.7-Gb/s DPSK receiver under strong optical filtering
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We study the effect of optical filter concatenation on a 42.7-Gb/s, 67% duty cycle RZ-DPSK signal and show that system performance can be greatly improved when the balanced DPSK receiver is intentionally amplitude imbalanced.

articleTitle: Ultra-compact, 0.5-Tb/s parallel-WDM optical interconnect
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We discuss a 12-fiber /spl times/ 4-wavelength /spl times/ 10.4-Gbit/s short-distance parallel-wavelength-division-multiplexed optical interconnect. The 0.5-Tbit/s transmitter and receiver assemblies each have a 5 /spl times/ 8-mm footprint and together consume 2.95 W.

articleTitle: Evaluation of partially loaded systems
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Evaluation of partially loaded systems is reviewed through experimental verifications. Considering the effects of the newly added signals during upgrade, allocation of dummy lights, replacement of dummy lights and interaction of inter-channels are discussed.

articleTitle: Design of sparse grooming networks for transporting dynamic multi-granularity sub-wavelength traffic
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: A sparse grooming network (SGN) is a cost-effective solution to provision multi-granularity sub-wave length connections with stringent budget constraints. We address the design of SGNs by proposing efficient sparse grooming algorithms and G-node placement heuristics.

articleTitle: Novel first and second order polarization mode dispersion emulator
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: A novel, simple and low-cost PMD emulator design is demonstrated in which the multiple polarization scrambling stages are replaced by a single, customized polarization controller. Simulation and experiment confirm that first and second order statistics are accurately emulated.

articleTitle: 40-Gb/s optical 3R regeneration using a traveling-wave electroabsorption modulator-based optical clock recovery
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We demonstrate a novel 40-Gb/s optical 3R regenerator that utilizes a traveling-wave electroabsorption modulator-based optical clock recovery. A regenerative fiber XPM wavelength converter is used to implement re-shaping function. 3R regeneration is demonstrated with a reduced timing jitter.

articleTitle: Virtual grouped-wavelength-path switching based on QPM-LN waveband converter and supercontinuum wavelength-bank source
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Virtual grouped-wavelength-path switching is proposed and demonstrated based on polarization-independent waveband conversion in QPM-LN and supercontinuum wavelength-bank source. The 64 ch-10 Gbit/s waveband is wavelength-converted, switched and transmitted through field-installed fibers in the JGN II test bed.

articleTitle: A 10 Gb/s adaptive equalizer with integrated clock and data recovery for optical transmission systems
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: A self-adaptive electronic equalizer with integrated clock and data recovery is presented. The capacity of the device to mitigate signal impairments at 10 Gb/s is demonstrated using three electrical channels having up to 3.5 unit intervals of intersymbol interference.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of femtosecond switching of a fully packaged all-optical switch
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate femtosecond switching of a fully packaged hybrid-integrated Mach-Zehnder switch. A record switching window of 620 fs at full-width-half-maximum is achieved.

articleTitle: Design and demonstration of a reconfigurable metro-regional WDM 32 /spl times/ 10 Gb/s system scaling beyond 500 kin of G.652 fiber
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We demonstrate a industrial-strength 32 /spl times/ 10 Gb/s WDM system with multiple reconfigurable optical-add/drop nodes that enables metro regional networks to cost-effectively scale to < 500 km with span and installation/maintenance flexibility.

articleTitle: PMD mitigation application of MZI-SOA based optical 2R regeneration in the receiver
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We propose a new application of the MZI-SOA-based optical-2R regeneration, which can exactly compensate for the PMD (polarization mode dispersion) penalty resulting from 35ps-DGD in a 10 Gb/s system with 18 dB OSNR/0.1 nm. This demonstrates the effectiveness of the optical-2R in the receiver for PMD mitigation.

articleTitle: Tuneable second harmonic generation in long periodically poled optical fibres
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: A widely tuneable second harmonic generator in a periodically poled germanosilicate optical fibre is demonstrated for the first time. Broadband wavelength tuning of 27.8 nm is achieved using a highly efficient compression tuneable package demonstrated with fibre Bragg gratings.

articleTitle: Demonstration of a 6 /spl times/ 10 Gb/s multiuser time-slotted SPECTS O-CDMA network testbed
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We demonstrate error-free performance of a six-user, 10 Gb/s/user, time-slotted SPECTS (spectral phase encoded time spreading) O-CDMA network testbed. Careful system engineering and a nonlinear thresholder effectively suppress multiuser interference.

articleTitle: Single-mode-fiber direct coupled 10-Gbps VCSEL-TOSA on flexible substrate platform
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: A new-type 10-Gbps VCSEL-TOSA (vertical cavity surface emitting laser transmitter optical sub-assembly) was demonstrated with single-mode-fiber direct coupling optics and a flexible substrate platform. The TOSA showed high fiber coupling efficiency (-1.6 dB) and clear 10-Gbps eye-opening with -2.6 dBm average optical power and 6 dB extinction ratio.

articleTitle: Electrical estimation of conditional probability for maximum-likelihood based PMD mitigation [polarization mode dispersion]
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Accurate probability density functions in the presence of both all-order PMD and amplified spontaneous emission (ASE) noise are estimated electronically, and used for maximum likelihood sequence estimation and a maximum a posteriori detection to mitigate PMD in the presence of ASE noise.

articleTitle: Chirp-controlled EA-modulator/SOA/widely-tunable laser transmitter
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We report on chirp-controlled optical modulation realized using a semiconductor optical amplifier and an electroabsorption modulator monolithically integrated with a widely-tunable laser. The chirp parameter can be adjusted from +1.0 to -0.7 across 30 nm tuning range.

articleTitle: Reducing costs for first one mile FTTH lines
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: A variety of strategies have been implemented to bring installation costs to near metallic wire levels, in consideration of suiting the layout of house and efficiency for FTTH drop and indoor lines.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of a theoretically optimum optical duobinary transmission system
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: A theoretically optimum optical duobinary transmission system is demonstrated experimentally at 10 Gb/s. The optimum duobinary system achieves a 4.4 dB enhancement in optically pre-amplified receiver sensitivity compared to a conventional duobinary system.

articleTitle: RF/IP hybrid network for video delivery over FTTP
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: There are two network architectures touted for video delivery in an FTTP network: CATV-like video over RF using, for example, the 1550 nm PON enhancement band; switched video-over-IP over the access network. Both quantitative cost models and qualitative analysis shows a RF/IP hybrid network, which uses the RF overlay for broadcast content and the IP access network for targeted content is the best architecture for delivering voice, video, and data.

articleTitle: Duty ratio control of nonlinear phase noise in dispersion managed WDM systems using RZ-DPSK modulation
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We show that the performance of dispersion managed WDM systems using the RZ-DPSK modulation format as limited by nonlinear mixing between signal and noise may be significantly improved by properly adjusting the signal duty ratio.

articleTitle: Labeling of 40 Gbit/s DPSK payload using in-band subcarrier multiplexing
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: The transmission feasibility of a 40 Gbit/s DPSK payload with in-band SCM (subcarrier multiplexing) labeling at 3 GHz subcarrier frequency is experimentally verified over 80 km NZDSF (nonzero dispersion shifted fiber).

articleTitle: Achievement of 1 bit/s/Hz information spectral density using coherent WDM
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Coherent WDM - a new technique for high-spectral density - is proposed and demonstrated. Transmission of 42.66 Gbit/s NRZ binary data channels at 1bit/s/Hz is achieved in a single polarisation using a WDM comb source with phase control.

articleTitle: MZI based 8-channel wideband WDM filter array with low loss ripple and high isolation using silica-based PLC [planar lightwave circuits]
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We demonstrated a novel MZI (Mach Zehnder interferometer) based 8-channel WDM filter array with a low loss ripple and a high isolation for B-PON systems and obtained a loss ripple of <0.77 dB, and an isolation of >32 dB for all passbands and all channels.

articleTitle: Channel capacity of fiberoptic communication systems with amplified spontaneous emission noise
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We evaluate the capacity of fiberoptic channels dominated by linear amplified spontaneous emission noise for different modulation formats. Based on the channel capacities, we discuss possible gains from different modulation and coding techniques.

articleTitle: Common shallow ridge waveguide laser-electroabsorption modulator using lateral ion implantation
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: For the first time, a laser and high-speed modulator are integrated using a common shallow etched ridge waveguide. Ion implantation lateral to the modulator ridge provides electrical isolation suitable for 10 Gb/s long reach, 55 /spl deg/C operation.

articleTitle: Programmable optical buffering using fiber Bragg gratings combined with a widely-tunable wavelength converter
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: A 40 Gbps RZ all-optical buffering method, implemented by FBG and tunable wavelength converter, is presented. Preliminary results of time-delay up to 7 /spl mu/s and pulse broadening were measured. System measurements at 10 Gbps show the desired delay programmability.

articleTitle: Characterization of optical noise in measurements of Stokes parameters: theory and experiment
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: The optical noise induced by Gaussian sources in measurements of Stokes parameters is characterized at the output of a first-order polarization mode dispersion medium, and is shown to be generally different for each Stokes parameter.

articleTitle: Narrow-bandwidth acousto-optic tunable filter with low polarization dependence
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We demonstrate a narrow-bandwidth all-fiber acousto-optic tunable filter with low polarization dependence using a dispersion compensating fiber. The 3-dB bandwidth at 10-dB notch was 0.66 nm, and the polarization-dependent wavelength shift was 0.04 nm.

articleTitle: 2-D array wavelength demultiplexing by hybrid waveguide and free-space optics
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We demonstrate wavelength demultiplexing into a raster-scanned 8/spl times/9 array by combining a 1/spl times/8 arrayed waveguide grating with a free-space grating multiplexer. 9 diffraction orders from each AWG output are separated onto a 2D array on an InGaAs camera or coupled into a scanned output fiber. This first proof-of-principle device had 0.2 nm channel -20 dB width, >35 dB spectral extinction and 15 to 25 dB insertion loss over the 70 nm operating range.

articleTitle: Electronic dispersion compensation of non-ideal multimode fiber links
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We study the capability of electronic filters to equalize challenging examples of 500 MHz-km compliant 62.5 micron multimode fibers representative of the installed base. Most cannot be equalized via conventional EDC with acceptable power penalty.

articleTitle: A novel optical label swapping scheme for DPSK data transmissions using optical carrier suppression and separation technique without requiring a conventional wavelength converter
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We demonstrate a novel all-optical label swapping scheme using optical carrier suppression and separation technique without requiring any conventional wavelength converter in an OLS network carrying DPSK payload and OOK label over 140 Km SMF fibers.

articleTitle: DPSK performance in field and laboratory experiments
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Recent long-haul laboratory and field studies using the DPSK format are discussed. Comparison with OOK performance is presented. DPSK performance is discussed with respect to a number of system parameters.

articleTitle: Temperature insensitive operation of widely tunable hollow waveguide grating
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We demonstrate the widely tunable operation and low temperature dependence of a hollow waveguide grating for the first time. The obtained tuning range and temperature sensitivity of the grating filter wavelength is 10 nm and less than 0.016 nm/K, respectively.

articleTitle: A burst-mode optical receiver with high sensitivity using a PIN-PD for a 1.25 Gbit/s PON system
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: A 1.25-Gbit/s burst-mode optical receiver for access networks was developed. We devised transimpedance amplifier (TIA) and limiting amplifier (LIM) circuits using a PIN-PD instead of an APD, and the receiver exhibits high sensitivity of -30 dBm.

articleTitle: Single-mode operation in silica-core Bragg fibers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Silica-core Bragg fibers with a diameter below 10 /spl mu/m are fabricated to achieve single-mode transmission. The core of the fiber is drawn from a conventional single-mode fiber and multilayer cladding is formed on the outside by sputtering deposition of Si and SiO/sub 2/ layers. Bandgap guidance over a broadband wavelength range and the mode profile which corresponds with HE/sub 11/ mode are observed.

articleTitle: In-line signal quality monitoring based on asynchronous amplitude histogram for NRZ-DPSK systems [optical fiber communication]
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We have demonstrated novel in-service signal quality monitoring technique for constant amplitude NRZ-DPSK signals using asynchronous amplitude histogram evaluation. Information about dispersion and OSNR can be directly extracted from the amplitude histogram of the NRZ-DPSK signal.

articleTitle: Novel time domain add/drop multiplexer based on double-pumped four-wave-mixing and cross-phase-modulation induced spectral shift in a semiconductor optical amplifier
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Channel extraction and clearing for an all-optical add/drop multiplexer is demonstrated in a novel configuration exploiting both four-wave-mixing and cross-phase-modulation in a single semiconductor optical amplifier. The scheme is insensitive to signal input polarization and wavelength.

articleTitle: Chromatic dispersion measurement of SOA in C + L band by self-tracking real-time interferometry
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Chromatic dispersion in an SOA is characterized by high-accuracy broadband spectral interferometry. The chromatic dispersion is dominated by gain-induced frequency-dependent refractive index with a dispersion slope of 0.132 ps/nm/sup 2/ at 100-mA injection current.

articleTitle: Demonstration and performance analysis of gigabit-Ethernet PON system accommodating 64 ONUs
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We have demonstrated a two-wavelength gigabit-Ethernet PON system accommodating 64 ONU, and have evaluated its performance to clarify the feasibility of commercial applications. We have confirmed that high-quality triple play services can be achieved with high throughput.

articleTitle: Correlation between gain and buildup-time fluctuations in ultrafast avalanche photodiodes and its effect on receiver sensitivity
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: The joint statistics of the random gain and random buildup time in ultrafast avalanche photodiodes is determined for the first time. It is shown that the strong correlation present adversely affects intersymbol-interference noise and receiver sensitivity at high transmission rates well beyond previously-known limits.

articleTitle: Nonlinear phase noise in phase-coded transmission
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We review nonlinear phase noise in phase-coded transmission systems, emphasizing experimental results. We describe measurements of nonlinear phase noise as well as its impact on 10-Gbit/s and 40-Gbit/s transmission systems.

articleTitle: Performance study of mesh restoration
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We perform a sensitivity analysis of shared mesh restoration times. Through extensive simulations, we identify the parameters that have the most impact on the overall restoration times.

articleTitle: Fiber transmission system application and limitation of multicanonical sampling in PMD emulation
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We apply multicanonical sampling to a 10-Gb/s fiber transmission system using a recirculating loop as a PMD emulator. With 22-ps average PMD, the probability density at 10/sup -5/ BER increases from 5/spl times/10/sup -4/ (Monte-Carlo) to 0.01 (multicanonical).

articleTitle: Long-term carrier envelope phase-locking of a PM fiber frequency comb source
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: The carrier envelope phase of a polarization-maintaining fiber frequency comb laser is stabilized for long periods of time using near orthogonal fast and slow controls of carrier envelope phase and repetition rate.

articleTitle: Peer/overlay hybrid optical network using protocol gateways of GMPLS and OIF-UNI/NNI
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Peer/overlay hybrid optical networks with protocol gateways of GMPLS and OIF-UNI/NNI were demonstrated for the first time. UNI connections were successfully established over a single TDM/photonic GMPLS domain as well as OIF E-NNI-based multiple domains.

articleTitle: 200 /spl times/ 200 automated optical fiber cross-connect equipment using a fiber-handling robot for optical cabling systems
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: An automated optical fiber cross-connect equipment, using a fiber-handling robot, reduces both operation and equipment costs and enables us to construct reliable optical networks for intelligent buildings and optical access network facilities.

articleTitle: 10 Gbit/s FSK transmission over 130 km SMF using group delay compensated balance detection
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: By using an integrated optical frequency-shift-keying (FSK) modulator, we demonstrate 10 Gbit/s optical FSK transmission over a 130 km single mode fiber. Fiber dispersion was compensated by a balanced photodetector with an optical delay.

articleTitle: Self-amplified passive optical network using 8B10B line coding properties in Gigabit-Ethernet protocol
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: A cost-effective self-amplified network in a Gigabit-Ethernet passive optical network is demonstrated using 8B10B line coding properties. We explain the operational principles and experimental results including transmitter and receiver margin for an upstream channel.

articleTitle: Novel packaging of parallel-optical interconnects for high-end servers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: A novel packaging concept is demonstrated where parallel-optical subassemblies are mounted on the same substrate as processor chips for processor-to-processor communication within a high-end server. A single-channel bit-error ratio <1.5/spl times/10/sup -15/ was measured at 8 Gbit/s.

articleTitle: Optical sampling system including clock recovery for 320 Gbit/s DPSK and OOK data signals
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Measurements of eye diagrams of 320 Gbit/s DPSK signals after 160 km transmission are reported using an optical sampling system with clock recovery and 1.0 ps resolution, which accepts amplitude or phase modulated data signals and allows measurements with large persistence time.

articleTitle: Novel pumping scheme study for fluoride-based thulium-doped fiber amplifier at 690 nm
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Simultaneous pumping of thulium-doped fiber amplifier (TDFA) with 690 nm and 1050 nm (or 1400 nm) is highly efficient and cost-competitive due to availability of 690 nm digital video disk (DVD) laser diodes.

articleTitle: Investigation of the spectrogram technique for the characterization of picosecond optical pulses
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: The accuracy of an implementation of the spectrogram technique based on an electroabsorption modulator providing a 30 ps gate is investigated. Picosecond pulses are accurately characterized with high dynamic range and high sensitivity.

articleTitle: Advanced thin-film filter for passive optical networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We describe an advanced high isolation thin-film filter for passive optical networks. A novel proprietary coating technology called "Grand-Ex technology" using an ion-beam sputtering process demonstrates the highest filter performance ever reported for triplexer modules. An advanced thin-film filter shows a transmission isolation and a reflection isolation of 44 dB and 52 dB, respectively, between a digital signal band at 1490 nm and a video signal band at 1555 nm.

articleTitle: Performance of DPSK and NRZ-OOK signals in a novel folded-path optical packet switch buffer
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: A novel and physically compact optical time delay buffer with nanoseconds reconfigurability is presented. Experiment results showed that the optimization of various design parameters resulted in greater range of delay value and smaller delay time step granularity.

articleTitle: Optical networking beyond 40 Gbit/s
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: 160 Gbit/s OTDM networks will need nodes with add-drop multiplexers to extract and insert channels at lower bitrates. We review the current status of add-drop multiplexing for bit rates up to 160 Gbit/s and beyond.

articleTitle: Optical parametric process for optical signal processing
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: After briefly introducing the application of the optical parametric process to optical communication, recent progress in parametric wavelength conversion is described. Features and issues of the phase-sensitive parametric amplifier are also mentioned.

articleTitle: Fast PMD and PDL measurement of aerial fiber
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: The fastest sampling of PMD (polarization-mode dispersion) of an aerial fiber is presented and aerial fiber PDL (polarization dependent loss) is studied for the first time. PMD and PDL are shown to be loosely correlated. PMD is shown to change at a rate <800 /spl mu/s.

articleTitle: Wavelength conversion of 40-Gbit/s NRZ signal using four-wave mixing in 40-cm-long bismuth oxide based highly-nonlinear optical fiber
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We demonstrate the use of an only 40-cm-long Bi/sub 2/O/sub 3/-based nonlinear fiber with /spl gamma/=1100 W/sup -1/km/sup -1/ to obtain FWM-based wavelength conversion. Error-free conversion of 40-Gbit/s NRZ signals over /spl sim/10 nm is achieved without any SBS suppression scheme.

articleTitle: Distinctive behaviour of long-period gratings in amplifying waveguides
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We describe a tuneable filter based on a long-period grating written in Er/sup +3/-doped core fiber. Integration of filtering and amplifying properties results in qualitatively new operational behaviour, that otherwise is impossible to realize using conventional gratings.

articleTitle: End-to-end layer-3 (IP) packet throughput and latency performance measurements in an all-optical label switched network with dynamic forwarding
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate dynamic IP-packet forwarding through an all-optical label-swapped network and for the first time report true end-to-end layer-3 IP throughput and latency performance measurements. There was no observable core throughput penalty and a 0.79 /spl mu/secs latency increase was measured for 40 to 1500 byte packets at OC-48 rates.

articleTitle: New high bandwidth single polarization fiber with elliptical central air hole
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: A new single polarization fiber with an elliptical central air hole is proposed. Effects of fiber design parameters on fiber performance are analyzed. Single polarization bandwidth as high as 240 nm is predicted.

articleTitle: Wavelength-tunable receiver channel selection and filtering using SG-DBR laser injection-locking
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: An injection-locked SG-DBR laser is used for wavelength-tunable receiver channel selection and filtering. Successful phase tracking of a 2 Gbit/s DPSK modulated signal at 10 GHz channel spacing was achieved.

articleTitle: A novel broadband asynchronous histogram technique for optical performance monitoring [optical fibre communication]
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We combine tunable narrowband filtering with asynchronous sampling to produce broadband histograms that measure frequency-resolved signal distortion. We demonstrate the technique using chirped WDM signals affected by filter detuning, dispersion and nonlinear effects.

articleTitle: Performance enhancement of differentiated services in E PON: smaller buffer and efficient traffic service isolation
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: The performances of differentiated services in E-PON can be enhanced by the QoS based bandwidth reservation. With dynamic service tracking, the data buffer size and the light-load penalty are reduced with the reliable traffic isolation

articleTitle: Parallel-optical interconnects and their applications
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Research and development on parallel-optical interconnects has continued for over a decade. A review is given of the applications of parallel optics, existing 12/spl times/2.5-Gbit/s parallel optics, recent 12/spl times/10-Gbit/s parallel optics, and next-generation optical interconnects.

articleTitle: Evanescent wave photonic crystal fiber tunable filter using dispersive optical polymers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We demonstrate wideband tunable photonic crystal fiber filters based on dispersive evanescent wave tunneling. The wavelength tuning range is /spl sim/400 nm by 10/spl deg/C temperature variation and the extinction ratio of power is above 45 dB.

articleTitle: Frequency multiplexing technique for relative-intensity-noise reduction
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: A 10 dB relative-intensity-noise reduction is achieved by a novel scheme that multiplexes local-oscillation frequency and intermediate frequencies. Simulations conducted to evaluate relative-intensity-noise levels match well the experimentally obtained data.

articleTitle: Directional coupling in hollow Bragg fiber bundles
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Coupling between TE01 modes of two collinear hollow-core Bragg fibers is characterized as a function of the inter-fiber separation and wavelength in a view of designing a directional coupler.

articleTitle: Silicon photonic crystals and photonic wires for ultradense optical integration
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Summary form only given. We review the latest results on the development of submicron silicon-on-insulator waveguiding structures - photonic crystals and single-mode strip waveguides (photonic wires).

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of 2 /spl times/ 10 Gb/s OCDMA system using cascaded long-period fiber gratings formed in dispersion compensating fiber
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: A 2/spl times/10 Gb/s OCDMA system using cascaded long-period fiber gratings, formed in dispersion compensating fiber with an inner-cladding structure, is presented. Two encoder/decoder pairs are fabricated and the coding performances between them are verified with BER measurements.

articleTitle: Maximum second order PMD in emulators - a geometric approach
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: A new geometric interpretation of second order PMD (SOPMD) is used to solve the problem of how the birefringent elements in an emulator should be oriented to maximize the SOPMD. Both depolarization and polarization-dependent chromatic dispersion are considered.

articleTitle: OFE - Optical nonlinear processmig
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Optical-frequency mixing can accomplish a variety of wavelength-and time-domain all-optical signal processing functions. Operation at speeds up to 160 Gb/s, bandwidths of 70 nm, and with as few as 400photon pulses have been demonstrated in periodicdly-poled lithium niobate (PPLN) devices.

articleTitle: Less temperature-sensitive F-B-SiO/sub 2/ waveguide on a crystallized glass substrate
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: A F-B-SiO/sub 2/ slab waveguide Bragg grating is fabricated on a multi-component crystallized glass substrate. A thermal shift of the Bragg wavelength as low as 3 pm/K, which is /spl sim/ 1/4 of a conventional device, is achieved.

articleTitle: Design and applications of all-optical regenerators
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: The applications and design considerations that drive the development of InP-based all-optical regenerators are summarized. The applications of the 2R regenerator are enumerated along with the design considerations for the fabrication of these devices.

articleTitle: Optical tuning of photonic bandgaps in dye-doped nematic liquid crystal photonic crystal fibers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: An all-optical modulator is demonstrated, which utilizes a pulsed 532 nm laser to modulate the spectral position of the bandgaps in a photonic crystal fiber infiltrated with a dye-doped nematic liquid crystal. In order to investigate the time response of the LCPBG fiber device, a low-power CW probe laser was coupled into the fiber together with the pulsed pump laser of 2.3 mW and we have demonstrated a modulation frequency of up to 2 kHz.

articleTitle: Er:Yb-doped waveguide amplifier and laser fabricated by using a new diode-pumped femtosecond oscillator
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We demonstrated for the first time effective amplification and laser action in a 20-mm long waveguide fabricated on a erbium-ytterbium-doped phosphate glass by means of femtosecond laser pulses. Gain in the full C-band with more than 2 dB/cm peak value and laser action with 2 dBm output power was achieved. Waveguides were manufactured using the 520-nm radiation from a frequency-doubled, diode-pumped cavity-dumped Yb:glass laser operating at 166 kHz repetition rate, with 300 fs pulse duration. A writing time of a few seconds is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Optical limiting and Raman amplification in silicon waveguides
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We investigate the effect of two-photon absorption and free-carrier absorption for continuous-wave light propagation in sub-micron size silicon wire waveguides, and experimentally observe net optical gain from stimulated Raman scattering in a silicon rib waveguide.

articleTitle: Air-guiding photonic bandgap fibers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We review the present state-of-the-art for air-guiding photonic bandgap fibers. Applications, loss mechanisms and future work is considered.

articleTitle: Adaptive opto-electronic compensator for excessive filtering, chromatic and polarization mode dispersion [optical fibre communication applications]
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We propose an opto-electronic equalizer combining optical and electronic equalizers optimized jointly by the novel opto-electronic least mean squares algorithm. Through simulation, we demonstrate that it can efficiently compensate GVD (group velocity dispersion), PMD and excessive optical filtering.

articleTitle: A fast-response dynamic bandwidth allocation scheme for an Ethernet PON
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: This paper proposes a novel dynamic bandwidth allocation scheme with fast response, which significantly reduces the processing-speed requirement of the optical line terminal. Moreover, the scheme can provide high bandwidth efficiency while ensuring a bandwidth guarantee.

articleTitle: Loss reduction in an arrayed-waveguide grating by introducing an interference fringe at the interface between slab and arrayed waveguides
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We propose a novel method for reducing the diffraction loss in an arrayed-waveguide grating (AWG), by introducing an interference fringe at the interface between slab and arrayed waveguides. We achieved a loss reduction of 0.42 dB with this method.

articleTitle: Ultrafast all-optical NOR gate based on intersubband and interband modulation operating at communication wavelengths
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: An ultrafast all-optical NOR gate using intersubband and interband transitions in quantum wells is proposed. A proof-of-principle experiment is demonstrated using InGaAs/AlAsSb coupled quantum well structures operating at communication wavelengths (1.55 /spl mu/m and 1.3 /spl mu/m).

articleTitle: Dynamic gain equalizer based on liquid crystal technology
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: The symmetric optical design and a liquid crystal attenuator array give dynamic gain equalizer low insertion loss and polarization dependent loss, as well as high spectral resolution and dynamic range in the operational temperature range.

articleTitle: Ultrafast optical delay line using soliton propagation between a time-prism pair
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Using soliton propagation between a time-prism pair, we apply time-prisms to ultrashort pulses and demonstrate an all-fiber, programmable optical delay line with a scan rate of 0.5 GHz, and a delay range of 33.0 ps.

articleTitle: Distributed feedback fiber laser with a novel structure
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: A DFB fiber laser with an equivalent phase shift (EPS) is studied and fabricated. A linewidth of 1.5 kHz is experimentally observed in the laser. A single-polarization DFB laser with EPS structure is also obtained.

articleTitle: Ultra low power optical feeder for VDSL
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We report an optical fiber system to feed street-based VDSL cabinets. Power requirement of 165 mW per customer is /spl sim/90% lower than conventional systems and can be provided from the customer end along a twisted copper pair.

articleTitle: Real options valuation for planning OXC introduction
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Real options valuation is an investment decision technique originating from the economic world of the stock options and aimed at valuing uncertain investments. This paper uses ROV for planning OXC introduction in a European backbone.

articleTitle: Broadly tunable optical parametric oscillators with up to 82-GHz pulse repetition rate and very high output power
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We present optical parametric oscillators with 39-GHz and 82-GHz repetition rates, generating 2.1 W and 0.9 W of average output power, respectively. The signal wavelength is broadly tunable in the 1.5-/spl mu/m spectral region.

articleTitle: Tunable passively mode-locked fibre ring laser
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: A polarization-dependent Mach-Zehnder amplitude modulator was used in the passively mode-locked fibre ring laser. When the modulator was biased at different voltages, stable soliton train with tunable repetition rates from 50 GHz to 300 GHz was observed.

articleTitle: OFP - Emerging applications and technologies
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We examine the intioduction of Ethernet services in carrier networks and the necessary requirements on the evolution of Ethernet feature-set. We outline how these requirements for carrier-grade operation can successfully be met.

articleTitle: Wavelength spacing tunable multiwavelength fiber laser with lasing wavelength selectivity
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a flexibly tunable multiwavelength fiber laser with multiple functionalities like the wide tuning range of the wavelength spacing and the lasing wavelength based on the hybrid gain medium.

articleTitle: Novel type of PMD compensator based on separation of PSP and DGD controls
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate a novel type of PMD (polarization mode dispersion) compensator (PMDC) that separates PSP (principal states of polarization) control from DGD (differential group delay) control with an automatically adaptive 40 Gb/s PMDC module manufactured on PCBs. The results showed that this method provided a very fast response time of /spl sim/2 /spl mu/s to PSP change and allowed a reduction in compensation time compared with the conventional method of alternately controlling PSP and DGD.

articleTitle: A high-speed tunable filter using a concave fiber mirror
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: A tunable Fabry-Perot filter using a concave mirror fabricated on the end of a fiber is demonstrated. The concave mirror simplifies angular alignment and reduces vibration sensitivity. A scanning rate of 150 kHz over a FSR of 47 nm with a finesse of 600 was demonstrated.

articleTitle: Progress on fiber poling and devices
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: One can induce second-order nonlinearity in fibers through poling. Electrooptical modulation, switching and wavelength conversion can thus be achieved. We describe accomplishments of the EU project GLAMOROUS in creating low-cost high performance electrooptic fiber components.

articleTitle: Effect of non-linearities on PMD
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: The magnitude and direction of the Polarization Mode Dispersion vector of a WDM channel is significantly affected by nonlinear polarization crosstalk from neighbouring chaunels within the PMD correlation bandwidth. Such non-linear interactions may firther significantIy impair dynamic networks

articleTitle: 1V operation laser diode for FTTH by using active multi-mode-interferometer (MMI)
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Active multi-mode-interferometer (MMI) laser diodes (LDs) achieved low operating voltage of only 1V at 10 mW light output (/spl lambda//spl ap/1.5 /spl mu/m), due to the significant resistance reduction of 60% compared to that of regular LDs, and 1 Gbps operation.

articleTitle: Phase noise and supermode suppression in harmonic mode-locked erbium-doped fiber laser with a semiconductor optical amplifier based high-pass filter
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: The variations and trade-off between the single side band phase noise, supermode noise suppression ratio and pulsewidth of a mode-locked erbium-doped fiber laser with an intra-cavity semiconductor optical amplifier based high-pass filter are discussed.

articleTitle: Coupled-resonator-induced transparency in a fiber system
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We observe splitting of the modes in a coupled-fiber-ring resonator system. This splitting leads to a greatly enhanced transmission (cancellation of absorption) on resonance. We show the analogies between this effect and classical electromagnetically induced transparency.

articleTitle: Reduction of nonlinear patterning effects in SOA-based all-optical switches using optical filtering
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We explain theoretically, and demonstrate and quantify experimentally, how appropriate filtering can reduce the dominant nonlinear patterning effect, which limits the performance of differential-mode SOA-based switches.

articleTitle: A novel technique for modulation alignment monitoring in RZ-DPSK systems using off-center optical filtering
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: A novel high-speed polarization-independent off-center optical filtering technique for monitoring alignment status between pulse generator and data modulator in RZ-DPSK systems is proposed and demonstrated. A monitoring dynamic range of 3.35 dB is achieved experimentally.

articleTitle: Novel segmented cascade electroabsorption modulator with improved bandwidth-extinction product
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: A new configuration for electroabsorption modulators is presented and demonstrated. Compared to a conventional device of the same length, a three-stage cascaded modulator triples the RC-bandwidth while maintaining the same extinction and insertion loss.

articleTitle: Performance optimization of nanocrystal-Si sensitized Er-doped waveguide amplifier
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We analyze the performance of nanocrystal-Si sensitized erbium doped waveguide amplifier, and suggest novel structures and operating methods which can be used to enhance its performance figures.
