With modest assumptions on the design parameters, including currently available pump LED power, we show that the performance target of 10 dB of gain with 0 dBm input signal can be achieved.

articleTitle: Alkali impurities and the long-wavelength hydrogen-induced aging loss in Ge-doped silica fibers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Significant hydrogen aging loss in the long-wavelengths (>1360 nm) caused by alkali impurities (Na, Li, and K) at ppma levels in Ge-doped silica fibers and its relevance to long-term reliability are discussed.

articleTitle: Recovery in multilayer optical networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.

articleTitle: A simple single-fiber CWDM metro/access ring network with unidirectional OADM and automatic protection
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a simple and effective CWDM metro/access network architecture using unidirectional OADM for optical protection in a hub/access-node single-fiber ring. This physical-ring/logical-star architecture provides greater simplicity over previous designs requiring bidirectional ADM.

articleTitle: Performance improvement for constant amplitude NRZ-DPSK transmission through modulation-pulse-pre-shaping
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We have demonstrated a novel modulation-pulse-pre-shaping technique to improve the transmission performance of constant amplitude NRZ-DPSK signal. Transmission distance is doubled using this method together with the optimization of phase modulation depth

articleTitle: Multimode fiber Bragg grating based fiber lasers and optical sensors
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We propose the use of multimode fiber Bragg gratings for realizing wavelength-switching erbium-doped fiber lasers and optical sensors. Two wavelength-switching techniques are studied by exploiting the mode spatial distribution characteristics in the multimode fiber.

articleTitle: Refractive index modulation in photonic crystal fibers induced by mechanical stress relaxation based on CO/sub 2/ laser irradiation
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Refractive index modulation in endlessly-single-mode photonic crystal fiber by CO/sub 2/ laser irradiation without surface-deformation is experimentally confirmed with a value of 1.68/spl times/10/sup -3/ for the first time. Mechanical stress relaxation in the fiber contributes to the effect.

articleTitle: PMD suppression method for photonic crystal fiber
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We have succeeded in reducing the PMD of PCF to 10% of its initial value by periodic bidirectional twisting without loss increasing and structural deformation. A PCF with PMD of 0.03 ps/rkm has been obtained.

articleTitle: A different time delay technique for supervising switch fabric in OXC
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: A novel supervising technique, based on different time-delay recognition scheme, to monitor the switch fabric of optical cross-connect (OXC) is proposed. This method features fast detection, high reliability, and switch fault location.

articleTitle: Nanowiring light
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Recent advances in the fabrication and manipulation of sub-wavelength optical fibers provide new methods for building chemical and biological sensors, generating supercontinuum light by nonlinear pulse propagation, and constructing microphotonic components and devices. We examine the properties of sub-wavelength dimension optical fibers as waveguides. The reported silica submicrometer- or nanometer-diameter wires are suitable for low-loss optical wave guiding. Thanks to their excellent uniformity, large length, high flexibility, and strength, these wires can be manipulated and assembled with high accuracy.

articleTitle: High peak power amplification: real limits on pulsed generation in optical fibers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Studies of multi-millijoule pulse generation revealed ultimate peak-power generation limits set by bulk damage and self-focusing in large-core fibers. Ultrashort pulse or narrow-linewidth amplification is more stringently limited by Raman and Brillouin scattering, and self-phase-modulation.

articleTitle: Optically tunable dispersion compensator based on coupled-cavity etalon structure
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We demonstrate for the first time an optically tunable dispersion compensator which is based on pumping a coupled-cavity etalon made in Er/Yb codoped fiber. The dispersion was tuned from -300 to +400 ps/nm in the experiment.

articleTitle: OFL - Novel devices
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We report out recent progress in Si wire waveguide fabrication and Si-based optical devices. The low-loss waveguides fabrication promises size reduction and high-density integration of passive and active functional optical circuits on a wafer.

articleTitle: Optical signal processing with PPLN nonlinear waveguides
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Optical-frequency mixing can accomplish a variety of wavelength- and time-domain all-optical signal processing functions. Operation at speeds up to 160 Gb/s, bandwidths of 70 nm, and with as few as 400-photon pulses have been demonstrated in periodically-poled lithium niobate (PPLN) devices.

articleTitle: OFG - Modulation techniques
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We experimentalIy generate positively and negatively chirped return-to-zero differential phase-shift keyed signals using a single Mach-Zehnder modulator at 10 Gb/s with a receiver sensitivity (at BER=lO-? of about 42 dBm in an optically pre-amplified receiver. 02005 Optical Society of America

articleTitle: Experimental performance comparison for a variety of single pump, highly efficient, dispersion compensating Raman/EDFA hybrid amplifiers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We experimentally compare the performance of our proposed single pump, Raman/EDFA hybrid amplifiers recycling residual Raman pump in a cascaded EDF located either after or prior to a DCF with that of a Raman assisted EDFA, the concept of which was proposed by Y. Kurosawa et al. (Proc. European Conf. on Optical Comm. ECOC2003, Tu3.2.5, 2003) in terms of gain, NF, nonlinearity, and BER.

articleTitle: Nonlinear and linear impairments in WDM transmissions employing multi-level DPSK modulation formats
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: The performance of multi-level DPSK modulation formats is investigated. The results include the relationship between the nonlinear impairments and number of signal levels, and the performance degradation due to linear cross-talk between the WDM channels.

articleTitle: Fiber optic biochemical sensing using colloidal gold-modified long period fiber grating
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We present a novel class of fiber-optic evanescent-wave sensor based on the modification of the grating portion of a long-period fiber grating with self-assembled gold colloids. The transmission spectra and optical properties of gold nanospheres change with the different refractive index of the environment near the surface of gold nanospheres. The sensor response of gold colloids increases linearly with solvents of increasing refractive index. When the colloidal surface was modified with DNP, results show that the signal increase linearly with increasing concentration of the analyte, and the detection limit of the sensor for anti-DNP is 8.43/spl times/10/sup -5/ g/mL or 3.8/spl times/10/sup -7/ M.

articleTitle: High extinction ratio in-fiber polarizer based on a 45/sup /spl deg//-tilted fiber bragg grating
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We report an in-fiber polarizer implemented using a 45deg-tilted fiber Bragg grating. Polarization extinction ratio of 28 dB at 1550 nm and HMFW over 80 nm has been demonstrated. When the un-polarized light passes this device, 99.5% of degree of polarization can be achieved

articleTitle: Widely wavelength tunable optical clock generation by use of injection locked DBR lasers with vernier gratings
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We propose a versatile optical clock generation method with 10 nm wavelength tunability using widely tunable DBR lasers. Injection locking was experimentally demonstrated for 30 GHz sinusoidal pulses at 1545 and 1560 nm as well.

articleTitle: 400 Gb/s (10-channel /spl times/ 40 Gb/s) DWDM photonic integrated circuits
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: A 10-channel transmitter and receiver DWDM photonic integrated circuit pair is demonstrated that is capable of transmitting and receiving data at 40 Gb/s per channel for an aggregate data communication rate of 400 Gb/s.

articleTitle: Single-mode high-index-core one-dimensional microstructured fiber with high nonlinearity
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We report the first fabrication of a high-index-core one-dimensional microstructured optical fiber with high index-contrast layers. Extrusion is utilized to fabricate the microstructured preform. Single mode guidance and high nonlinearity were observed in the fiber.

articleTitle: Microstructured phosphate glass fiber lasers with large mode areas
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We report fabrication and testing of the first phosphate glass microstructured fiber lasers. From cladding-pumped, 11 cm long fiber lasers of 430 /spl mu/m/sup 2/ core area we obtain 3 W CW output with good beam quality.

articleTitle: Effect of temperature variation on performance of optical phase conjugation
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We investigated the effect of temperature variation on the performance of fiber-based optical phase conjugation (OPC). The efficiency and bandwidth of OPC were degraded significantly by temperature variation due to the shift of zero-dispersion wavelength.

articleTitle: OFM - Detectors and receivers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: A photodetector module with 0.63 AIW responsivity at 1.55 pm and 85 GHt bandwidth has been developed. Successful operation at 80 and 160 Gbitis RZ data rates with Vpp > 0.5 V is reported.

articleTitle: Optimization of monitoring bandwidth for PMD monitoring technique based on RF spectrum analysis
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We investigated the optimum monitoring bandwidth for the PMD monitoring technique based on RF spectrum analysis. The results show that the monitoring bandwidth should be larger than 1 GHz for 10-Gb/s signals.

articleTitle: NIST optoelectronic measurements for fiber optic applications
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We describe current measurement capabilities as well as research focused on two areas: improving temporal and frequency response characterization of detectors and instrumentation using electro-optic sampling, and improving wavelength metrology using frequency combs.

articleTitle: OFH - Characterization and application of transmission fiber
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Transmission fiber, optimized for metropolitan applications, is realized and tested in typical system configuration. It offers a low dispersion and slope for broadband, uncompensated reach, while maintaining large effective area to suppress detrimental non-linear effects,

articleTitle: Erbium doped waveguide amplifiers (EDWAs) fabricated in novel bulk glasses using femtosecond pulses
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We present the results of optical characterisation experiments conducted on erbium doped waveguide amplifiers (EDWAs) fabricated in novel erbium doped bulk glasses using femtosecond pulses to modify the refractive index of the glass.

articleTitle: Characteristics and application of 50 /spl mu/m cladding optical fibers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Optical fibers of 50 /spl mu/m cladding diameter are fabricated and characterized for optical and mechanical performance. We show that the geometrical limit based on minimum loss needs to be considered while designing miniature fibers suitable for integration into optical components.

articleTitle: Reliable multi-path provisioning for next-generation SONET/SDH networks with virtual concatenation
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We propose effective multi-path bandwidth to provision a connection onto multiple paths while satisfying its availability requirement in next-generation SONET/SDH networks supporting virtual concatenation. Our proposal achieves lower blocking compared to the conventional single-path approach.

articleTitle: PMD induced penalty in the presence of fast polarization scrambling
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: PMD (polarization mode dispersion) induced penalty is investigated for an optical signal in a PMD medium under fast polarization scrambling. The Q penalty from pulse distortion is complementary to the Q penalty from timing jitter.

articleTitle: PSK homodyne detection using a pilot carrier for multi-bit/symbol transmission with inverse-RZ signal [optical communication applications]
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: PSK-homodyne detection using a polarization-multiplexed pilot-carrier in 2-bit/symbol transmission with an inverse-RZ signal at 20 Gb/s was demonstrated. The proposed scheme allows a high-extinction-ratio inverse-RZ signal by intensity-noise reduction (>15 dB) in a homodyne-balanced receiver.

articleTitle: Correlation-based measurement of distributed Raman gain in single-mode fibers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We present a new correlation-based pump-probe system to measure the distributed Raman gain in single-mode fibers. Our method shows better performance over the conventional method which uses a single pulse for the pump.

articleTitle: Raman gain and laser generation in germania-based core optical fibers in 1.1-2.2 /spl mu/m spectral range
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Raman amplification and generation in single mode fiber with germania-based core and silica cladding were investigated in 1.1-2.2 /spl mu/m spectral range. Fiber laser output power up to 10 W was obtained.

articleTitle: Microwave frequency upshifting technique for broadband arbitrary waveform generation
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: A new microwave frequency upshifting technique, based on a general temporal self-imaging effect in fiber, is proposed and demonstrated. Experimental results evidence the drastic bandwidth improvement provided by this technique as compared with conventional solutions.

articleTitle: Apodization of an elliptic-core two-mode fiber acousto-optic tunable filter
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We demonstrate a new apodization technique for an elliptic-core two-mode fiber acousto-optic tunable filter based on controlling the acoustic polarization. The intensity of the sidelobes in the filter spectrum was reduced by almost 6 dB using this apodization technique.

articleTitle: Fabrication and characterization of low loss photonic crystal waveguides based on InP substrate
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Photonic crystal waveguides, fabricated on InP substrate using an inductively coupled plasma etching process, show propagation losses of 40dB/mm with one missing row and of less than 10 dB/mm with three missing rows.

articleTitle: Field-trial demonstration of span launch power optimization using a subcarrier non-linearity monitor
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: This paper presents a 500-km field-trial demonstration of power optimization in a four span transmission link. A new non-linearity monitor method based on an in-band subcarrier was used to supervise the signal quality.

articleTitle: 1325 nm VCSELs emitting 1.2 mW single mode output in the 20-80°C temperature range
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Wafer fused InGaAlAs/AlGaAs VCSEL emitting in the vicinity of 1325 nm with InAlGaAs-based tunnel junction injection show record high 1.2 mW single mode output and 40 dB side-mode suppression ratio in the 20-80/spl deg/C temperature range and. good on-wafer device parameter uniformity.

articleTitle: All-optical regenerator using wavelength shift induced by cross-phase modulation in highly-nonlinear fibers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We propose and demonstrate an all-optical regenerator based on the wavelength shift induced by cross-phase modulation in a highly-nonlinear fiber. Regeneration of a 10-Gb/s signal using the proposed scheme improves the Q-factor by 1.8 dB.

articleTitle: Differential polarization-phase-shift keying without using polarization control
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We propose a novel modulation format whereby the polarization and phase of lightwaves can be differentially detected without using polarization control at the receiver. 20 Gbit/s transmission through 25 spans of 100 km SMF is possible.

articleTitle: Past, present, and future of customer-owned optical networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Customer owned networks first started about 10 years ago when organizations started purchasing dark fiber in the metro area. More recently they are now starting to extend their customer owned optical networks greater distance through the purchase of point to point wavelengths and/or construction of dedicated DWDM networks. Customer owned fiber is dark fiber that is dedicated to a single customer and where the customer is responsible for attaching the telecommunications equipment and lasers to "light" the fiber. Professional 3rd party companies who specialize in deploying customer owned dark fiber systems take care of the actual installation of the fiber and also maintain it on behalf of the customer. This paper gives an overview of the technology involved in customer owned networks along with possible applications and deployments.

articleTitle: Impact of modulation formats and SOA chirp on the throughput of SOA based OBS nodes
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: NRZ- and RZ-modulation formats are compared with respect to throughput limitations for OBS (optical burst switching) nodes by using different SOA (semiconductor optical amplifier) types. The impact of SOA chirp on the dispersion compensation characteristic of the fiber link is also included.

articleTitle: A novel optical frequency shift keying transmitter based on polarization modulation
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate a novel optical frequency shift keying transmitter based on polarization modulation. At its data rate, it features transparency and continuous tuning of wavelength spacing. The performance of the transmitter has been further experimentally characterized.

articleTitle: Characterization and measurement of the polarization properties of optical systems in the presence of PMD and PDL [communication systems]
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Techniques for measuring and characterizing the polarization properties of optical systems in the presence of PMD (polarization mode dispersion) and PDL (polarization dependent loss) are described, as well as methods for extraction of various physical parameters from the experimental data.

articleTitle: Femtosecond laser fabrication of photonic devices
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Recent developments in femtosecond laser fabrication of fiber Bragg grating (FBG) photonics devices and associated ultrafast beam interaction with phase masks are presented. These novel FBG devices are useful for telecommunication and fiber sensor applications.

articleTitle: 32 /spl times/ 11.4 Gbit/s transmission over 4000 km using dispersion managed 200 km spans
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We have transmitted 32 /spl times/ 11.4 Gbit/s signals over 4000 km using 200 km spans with pump power applicable for undersea cable systems. We believe that the result shows the feasibility of the 200 km spans for undersea cable systems.

articleTitle: Numerical modeling of the transient response in thulium-doped fiber amplifiers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: A transient response model for thulium-doped fiber amplifier is presented. With an optimally chosen method for numerical integration, we can successfully estimate the transient response of thulium-doped amplifier, which is worth consideration in the optical networking system.

articleTitle: Unequal OTDM channels in a 2R regenerated, dispersion managed transmission system
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: The dynamics of switching and transmission of an optical signal comprising individual OTDM channels of unequal amplitudes in a dispersion-managed link with in-line non-linear fibre loop mirrors is investigated for the first time.

articleTitle: Quantum dots for lasers, amplifiers and photonic systems
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Summary form only given. We demonstrated self-organised quantum dots (QD) to enable novel photonic devices like edge and surface emitting lasers, or amplifiers with dramatically improved properties and show potential for optical computers.

articleTitle: Capacity planning of survivable wavelength-routed networks for increase of traffic loads
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We propose a cost-effective capacity planning of survivable wavelength-routed networks optimized for initial traffic loads to study the effect of additional network costs corresponding to the increase in traffic demands with shared-path protection.

articleTitle: Ultra-high-Q (>100-million) micro-cavities on silicon for stimulated and parametric lasers sources
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Summary form only given. A new chip-based micro-cavity capable of Q factors as high as 500 million is reviewed. Fiber-coupled Raman and parametric oscillators having microwatt level threshold powers are demonstrated as well as narrow-linewidth erbium lasers.

articleTitle: All-optical SCM-to-TDM label format converters for interoperating optical-label switching networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We propose and demonstrate all-optical label-encoding format conversion from subcarrier-multiplexing to time-domain-multiplexing for 156.25 Mb/s labels and 10 Gb/s payload. The experiments show error-free operations with only 0.41 dB normalized power penalty for the payload.

articleTitle: Tunable 40 GHz pulse source based on XPM-induced wavelength shifting in highly nonlinear fiber
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: A simple and robust 40 GHz pulse source has been demonstrated by using cross-phase modulation induced wavelength shifting in 200 m highly nonlinear fiber with subsequent optical filtering. The generated pulses are pulse width and wavelength tunable.

articleTitle: Demonstration of two-way, multihop optical-code labeled control packet processing for optical burst switching
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Two-way, two-hop 8-chip bipolar optical-code labeled control packet processing, including label recognition, packet switching, and label swapping are experimentally demonstrated for optical path reservation in OBS network for the first time.

articleTitle: 1.5 /spl mu/m InGaAs/InGaAsP/InP quantum dot lasers operating CW at room temperature
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: CW operation of QD lasers emitting at /spl sim/1.5 /spl mu/m at room temperature have been demonstrated. J/sub th/ per QD stack of /spl sim/430 A/cm/sup 2/ is measured for broad area lasers with 5, 7, and 10 QD stacks.

articleTitle: OFD - Polymers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: : A novel replication technology for fabricating polymer optical waveguides has been developed. By utilizing this technology, optical coupler modules and a WDM module are successfully demonstrated with practical characteristics and high reliability for FTTH systems. (2005) Optical Society of America

articleTitle: Low probability jitter measurements in "live" serial data streams
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: BER testers measure CDFs (cumulative density functions) in real-time; however, BER applications have been limited to using repeating PRBS (pseudorandom binary sequence) or fixed sequences. The paper presents altering the decision circuit to allow CDF accumulation in any data stream including "live" traffic.

articleTitle: Leakage loss of air-guiding honeycomb photonic bandgap fiber
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We report a new class of air-guiding photonic bandgap fiber using honeycomb air-silica cladding design. Full-vector numerical simulation shows the leakage loss can be as small as 0.06 dB/m using eight cladding rings.

articleTitle: Accurate Raman gain measurement of field deployed optical fiber cables with small pumping power
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We have succeeded in measuring the Raman gain of field deployed optical cables accurately with an average pumping power of only about 25 mW. We assessed the fiber/cable dependency and the ambient temperature dependency of the Raman gain for forty fibers.

articleTitle: Experimental study on crosstalk in double-pumped fiber optic parametric amplifier
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: The performance of five WDM modulated channels amplified with a double-pumped fiber optic parametric amplifier is experimentally analysed. We observe that crosstalk between channels diminishes when the amplifier is designed with a shorter fiber.

articleTitle: Low cost dispersion sign monitor for 40Gb/s systems
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Precise control of tunable dispersion compensators requires dispersion sign monitoring. We demonstrate a novel low-cost per-channel dispersion sign monitor for nonlinear and noise limited networks With bit-rates up to 40Gb/s.

articleTitle: Glass-polymer hybrid devices for integrated optics
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We discuss the performance merits associated with the development of glass-polymer hybrid components. We describe the status and future prospects of hybrid components that include hybrid (athermal) arrayed waveguide grating devices and other building blocks for achieving higher levels of integration.

articleTitle: UV-written buried waveguide devices in epoxy-coated benzocyclobutene
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We find that properly treated epoxy (OPTOCAST 3505) is non-photosensitive at the UV-wavelength 248 nm. Using it as the cladding material, several buried channel waveguide devices written into benzocyclobutene by the UV technique are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Thin flexible linear polarizer of silver-dispersed polyimide blend film exhibiting high extinction ratios in near-IR region
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Flexible thin-film (19 /spl mu/m-thick) polarizers consisting of silver nanoparticles having rodlike shapes dispersed in polyimide blend films were prepared. Linear polarizing character with extinction ratios >20 dB and transparencies >75% were obtained in a wide-range of wavelengths.

articleTitle: Deploying optical PMD compensators
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Adaptive compensators are considered as an attractive way to overcome limitations caused by PMD in 40G systems and beyond. However, numerous problems still prevent this technology from being deployed in commercial systems. The paper gives an overview over existing solutions.

articleTitle: Optical satellite networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: With high-speed space optical crosslinks, an optical satellite network as part of a larger integrated space-terrestrial network is now feasible. This radical technology building block can have profound transforming effects on space system architectures.

articleTitle: Pulse compression in line defect photonic crystal waveguide
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: The dispersion properties of a membrane-type line-defect photonic crystal waveguide were investigated using short optical pulses. Group velocity dispersion larger than 10 ps/(mm/spl times/nm) were measured and pulse compression of approximately 60% was demonstrated.

articleTitle: Impact of RZ pulse carver phase errors on optical DQPSK
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: The impact of phase errors caused by imperfect return-to-zero (RZ) pulse carving on optical differential quadrature phase-shift keying (DQPSK) is analyzed. The two-symbol-delayed interferometric demodulation is proposed as an effective means to mitigate this degradation.

articleTitle: First experimental demonstration of IP-client-to-IP-client video streaming application over an all-optical label-switching network with edge routers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We demonstrate, for the first time to our knowledge, successful transmission and switching of video streaming traffic from an IP-client to an IP-client over an optical label-switching network testbed.

articleTitle: Overview on "Multi-partner European test beds for research networking" - a European research networking initiative
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: MUPPET (multi-partner European test beds for research networking) is a research project funded by the European Commission aiming to integrate and validate ASON/GMPLS technology and solutions as enablers for future upgrades to European research infrastructures.

articleTitle: Q penalties due to pump phase modulation in FOPAs
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We investigate Q penalties in FOPAs arising from variations of the parametric gain originated by pump phase modulation. We show that these penalties are strongly reduced in fibers with large variations of the zero dispersion wavelength (lambda<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub>)

articleTitle: Radiation-pressure-driven micro-mechanical oscillator
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We demonstrate for the first time, self generation of mechanical vibrations at RF frequencies stimulated directly by the radiation pressure of circulating photons within optical micro-cavities.

articleTitle: Waveguiding of orbital angular momentum light using chiral-selectivity azimuthally graded index fibre
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We describe a novel chiral azimuthally graded-index fibre which guides only one handedness of orbital angular momentum light. Such fibre may find application in physical layer cryptography using photons with high order orbital angular momentum.

articleTitle: Recent progress of digital cinema over optical networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: A new super high definition digital cinema distribution system with a resolution of 8-million (4K/spl times/2K) pixels is developed. This system opens the door to the next generation of cinema-class digital content distribution over optical networks.

articleTitle: Investigation of cross gain modulation in 200-km Raman amplified spans with bidirectional pumping
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We have isolated and measured the impairment due to cross gain modulation in 200-km bidirectionally pumped fiber spans. The penalty depends on fiber dispersion characteristics and can be small for up to 20 dB on-off co-gain.

articleTitle: Survivable and reconfigurable meteropolitan DWDM network with up to 40Gb/s line rates
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: This paper summarizes the results of the field trial that successfully completed the METEOR consortium, 1ST-1999-10402. We demonstrate a survivable metropolitan optical network accommodating line rates of up to 40 Gb/s at 100 GHz channel spacing

articleTitle: Isolator-free directly modulated complex-coupled DFB lasers for low cost applications
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Complex-coupled and index-coupled DFB lasers are fabricated and characterized regarding their feedback sensitivity. The feedback stability is improved by 15 dB using the complex coupling. BER measurements demonstrate the potential for isolator-free transmitter application.

articleTitle: High-power (04mW) L-band tunable DFB laser array module using current tuning
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: A widely-tunable DFB-laser array module operating in the Lband is developed. It can cover a wide range (3.15 THz) with a high SMSR (>45 dB). A fiber-output power of 40 mW and high-speed switching are achieved by LD current tuning.

articleTitle: Experimental investigation of a frequency-nondegenerate phase-sensitive optical parametric amplifier
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We demonstrate the first fiber-optic phase-sensitive parametric amplifier based on frequency-nondegenerate four-wave mixing. An input signal is phase-sensitively amplified and the measured gain response matches well with the theory.

articleTitle: Nearly quantum-limited timing jitter of passively mode-locked 10-GHz diode-pumped Er:Yb:glass lasers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: A novel measurement scheme demonstrates that the timing jitter of free-running passively mode-locked 10-GHz Er:Yb:glass lasers can be close to the quantum limit. With feedback stabilization, even lower jitter (27 fs rms, 6 Hz-1.56 MHz) is achieved.

articleTitle: 1/spl times/4 all-optical packet switch with all-optical header processing
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We demonstrated a 1/spl times/4 all-optical packet switch using injection-locking in a Fabry-Perot laser diode for all-optical header processing and cross gain modulation in an SOA for packet switching.

articleTitle: Fiber-based all-optical sampling system with simultaneous -17 dBm sensitivity, 1 ps temporal resolution and 60 nm optical bandwidth [all optical sampling oscilloscope applications]
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We demonstrate a fiber four-wave mixing based all-optical sampling system with simultaneous -17 dBm sensitivity, 1 ps temporal resolution and 60 nm optical bandwidth for all optical sampling oscilloscope applications.

articleTitle: Tunable single-frequency erbiurn-doped fiber ring laser with 25 GHz channel spacing based on the ITU-T grid
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Discretely tunable single-mode erbium-doped fiber ring laser is fabricated with tuning range over 70 nm in C- and L-band utilizing a Fabry-Perot etalon and a saturable absorber. This matches to ITU-T 25-GHz frequency grid at 361 channels with excellent flatness

articleTitle: Field trial of 40-Gbit/s wavelength path quality assurance using GMPLS-controued all-optical 2R regenerator
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We have successfully demonstrated a field trial of 40-GWs wavelength path quality assurance by applying a GMPLS-controlled all-optical 2R regenerator that is incorporated in multilayer integration system among GMPLS control, measurement, and data planes.

articleTitle: Extended optical broadcasting in interconnected flexible metro WDM ring networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: An "extended" broadcast and select architecture across transparently connected metro core and metro collector/access ring networks are demonstrated. WDM channel paths can be dynamically reconfigured and selectively broadcast into multiple areas of metro access networks.

articleTitle: A highly efficient and selective spatial mode transformer for high-order-mode dispersion compensation modules
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: A method to implement highly efficient and selective transformation between different fiber modes is presented. It is based on free space wavefront manipulation and enables the construction of high performance high-order mode dispersion compensating modules.

articleTitle: Third-order cascaded Raman amplification benefits for 10 Gbits/s WDM unrepeated transmission systems
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Benefits provided by third-order Raman pumping in unrepeated WDM transmission systems are quantified in terms of BER performances at 10 Gb/s. Double-Rayleigh scattering noise induces transmission penalties at very high on-off Raman gain and must be kept under control.

articleTitle: Enhanced supercontinuum generation near fiber Bragg resonances
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We show that supercontinuum generation in a nonlinear fiber containing a Bragg grating is greatly modified near the Bragg resonance. We demonstrate enhancement of more than 10 times in fibers with single and multiple grating resonances.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional waveguide interconnection formed with femtosecond laser in planar lightwave circuits
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: The 3-dimensional interconnection of waveguides in planar lightwave circuits (PLCs) is demonstrated for the first time. By writing 3-dimensional waveguides that cross other waveguides, the femtosecond laser successfully interconnects PLC waveguides with low loss.

articleTitle: Nonlinear and active optical III-V semiconductor micro-resonators
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We review our work on GaAs-AlGaAs and GaInAsP-InP optical micro-ring resonators. We have demonstrated passive linear filters and wavelength multiplexers/demultiplexers. Nonlinear rings demonstrated include logic gates and time-domain demultiplexers. Active rings demonstrated include tunable filters using the quadratic electro-optic effect, and ring amplifiers and lasers. The latter, when reverse biased, become modulators by the electro-absorption effect.

articleTitle: Effect of erbium ion concentration on gain spectral hole burning in silica-based erbium-doped fiber
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: The erbium concentration dependence of gain spectral hole burning in EDF was investigated. We propose the energy transfer mechanism between Er ions, which contributes to the suppression of the second-hole at 1530 nm.

articleTitle: Fiber-bragg-grating force sensor based on a wavelength switching actively mode-locked fiber laser
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We present an FBG transverse-force sensor based on a wavelength-switching actively mode-locked fiber laser. The output is represented by the time difference between the generated pulses, which is insensitive to temperature changes on the FBG

articleTitle: Sensing characteristics of long-period fiber gratings in photonic crystal fiber imprinted by CO/sub 2/ laser
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: A long period fiber grating imprinted in a pure-silica PCF (photonic crystal fiber) by using CO/sub 2/ laser beams is presented. The sensitivities of the resonant wavelength under bending, strain, and temperature were measured to be +16.4 nm-m, -0.95 pm//spl mu//spl epsiv/, and +9 pm//spl deg/C, respectively.

articleTitle: Demonstration of a 160-Gb/s group-alternating phase CSRZ format featuring simplified clock recovery and improved nonlinear performance
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a new 160-Gbit/s signal format employing phase inversion of every four consecutive bits in a group. This format enables simple clock recovery by spectral filtering, and increases the nonlinear tolerance compared to CSRZ signals.

articleTitle: Optical sampling technologies and applications
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Technologies for optical sampling systems are reviewed. Highest temporal resolution is achieved by frequency mixing in nonlinear crystals or fibers. Applications include the investigation of eye diagram distortions due to fiber nonlinearity, dispersion and PMD.

articleTitle: All-optical conversion from short-reach signal to long-reach signal and its operation in wide wavelength range
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate all-optical conversion at 10 Gb/s from short-reach signal generated by a directly modulated laser diode to long-reach signal useful for transmission over 80-km standard single mode fiber without chromatic dispersion compensation. Operation in a wide output wavelength range over 30 nm is also demonstrated.

articleTitle: 14.7 dB/mm TE mode nonreciprocal propagation in an InGaAsP/InP active waveguide optical isolator
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We have fabricated TE mode InGaAsP/InP active waveguide optical isolators demonstrating 14.7dB/mm TE mode isolation ratio with reduced insertion loss at the wavelength of 1550nm for monolithically integratable optical isolators.

articleTitle: Investigation of new erbium doped fiber design with improved splice performance
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: An erbium doped fiber (EDF) having a new type of refractive index profile, useful for optimizing fusion splicing abilities, is studied with respect to splice performance and gain characteristics.

articleTitle: Optical noise estimation using direct measurement of constellation diagrams by linear optical sampling
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Constellation diagrams of the electric field of optical sources are directly measured using linear optical sampling. The noise induced by the data modulator, amplified spontaneous emission and nonlinear propagation (i.e. Gordon-Mollenauer effect) are accurately characterized.

articleTitle: Long-haul "hut-skipped" transmission of mixed 10 & 40 Gb/s signals over deployed SSMF fiber in MCI's Dallas fiber loop using hybrid Raman-erbium doped fiber amplifiers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: This paper reports results of the first field-deployed "hut-skipping" line architecture using hybrid Raman-erbium doped fiber amplifiers (EDFA) and SSMF. Total transmission distance reached 640 km at 40 Gb/s with deployable lifetime margin using MCI's metro fiber ring.

articleTitle: Chirp reduction of /spl pi//2 alternate-phase pulses by optical filtering
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate that the frequency chirp in sinusoidal-phase-modulated /spl pi//2 alternate-phase pulses can be greatly reduced by optical filtering. A theoretical analysis shows the optimal modulation depth is approximately 0.56/spl pi/.

articleTitle: Implications of nonlinear interaction of signal and noise in low-OSNR transmission systems with FEC [optical fiber communication]
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We review the performance degradation due to noise parametric gain in long-haul single-channel NRZ terrestrial systems working at low OSNR and its implications on system design in the presence of forward error correction.

articleTitle: Long wavelength VCSELs
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Single-mode AlGaInAs/InP VCSELs for the 1.4-2 /spl mu/m wavelength range with sub-mA threshold currents, <1 V threshold voltage, >100/spl deg/C CW operation, single-mode operation with SMSR of 50 dB and modulation bandwidth up to 10 Gbit/s are presented.

articleTitle: Probabilistic graphical models for resilience of all-optical networks under crosstalk attacks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We develop a framework based on probabilistic graphical models to study the resilience of all-optical networks under crosstalk attacks. Using this framework, we identify key factors that affect the network resilience.

articleTitle: Service-driven networks for packet-aware transport
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: This paper presents the packet-aware transport network (PATN). We also present customer premise capabilities critical to providing new Ethernet services. Experimental results for various services from the customer premise with the PATN architecture are also presented.

articleTitle: Optical-fiber-based autocorrelation technique using a tunable DGD element and highly-nonlinear fiber
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We demonstrate a novel optical-fiber-based autocorrelator using a tunable differential group delay (DGD) element and highly nonlinear fiber. 20G, 40G, and 80G pulse widths are measured. Our measurement results agree well with the measurements using a conventional technique.

articleTitle: Self-controlled all-optical label and payload separator for variable length bursts in a time-serial IM/DPSK scheme
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We demonstrate an all-optical label and payload separator. The proposed scheme supports variable length and bitrate burst format and uses IM and DPSK modulation format for the label and payload, respectively.

articleTitle: Quantum dots for semiconductor optical amplifiers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: This paper reviews the recent progress of quantum-dot semiconductor optical amplifiers, especially highlighting the properties of ultrawide band, high power, and low distortion, and signal regeneration at 40 Gb/s newly achieved in the 1.5 /spl mu/m band.

articleTitle: Bit error rate estimation of DPSK modulated fiber-optic systems using multicanonical Monte-Carlo simulations
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We report the first implementation of the multicanonical Monte-Carlo simulation method to phase modulated optical communications systems. The method is used to validate a theoretical approach for estimating bit error rates in DPSK systems. The simulations validate the closed form model predictions that for a wide range of parameters of interest, the phase noise, which determines the BER, can be approximated as Gaussian.

articleTitle: Design of comb-like profiled fiber for efficient pulse compression based on stationary rescaled-pulse propagation
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We propose the design procedure of a comb-like profiled fiber compressor based on stationary rescaled-pulse propagation, and demonstrate optical pulse compression of a 7-ps pulse train to 375-fs through the designed compressor with only four steps.

articleTitle: All-optical DPSK-signal-regeneration based on a NOLM-setup
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We present a novel concept for all-optical DPSK signal regeneration based on a directionally attenuated non linear loop mirror (DA-NOLM).

articleTitle: Reconfigurable optical add-drop multiplexer (ROADM) with integrated sub-band optical cross-connect
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We demonstrate a monolithic high-performance reconfigurable optical add-drop multiplexer (ROADM) with integrated 24/spl times/8 wavelength selecting optical cross-connect. Eight of the 24/spl times/100 GHz WDM channels may be dropped to any of 8 wavelength-independent drop ports.

articleTitle: Compact high efficiency bends in perfluorocyclobutyl polymer waveguides
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We report the design, fabrication, and measurement of high efficiency, compact 45/spl deg/ single air interface bends in perfluorcyclobutyl (PFCB) copolymer waveguides. Experimental measurement reveals a low loss of 0.30/spl plusmn/0.03 dB/bend for TM polarization and 0.33/spl plusmn/0.03 dB/bend for TE polarization.

articleTitle: This is the way - Network cost impact of solutions for mitigating optical impairments: comparison of methods, techniques, and practical deployment constraints
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.

articleTitle: All-optical analog-to-cligital conversion by slicing supercontinuum spectrum and switching with nonlinear optical loop mirror
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We propose a novel all-optical analog-to-digital conversion scheme consisting of the quantization by slicing supercontinuum spectrum and the coding by switching pulses with a nonlinear optica1 loop mirror. The proposed scheme is experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: A new architecture for counterpropagation-based photonic regeneration and reshaping
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: This paper presents the honeycomb architecture for performing photonic regeneration and re-shaping in the counter-propagation. We demonstrate the suppression of undesired gain compression and cross-gain modulation effects along with significant improvement of input power sensitivity.

articleTitle: Optical packet labeling using polarization shift keying (PoISK) label and amplitude shift keying (ASK) payload
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We demonstrate optical label encoding/swapping of an orthogonal-labeled signal using 10 Gb/s-ASK-payload and 2.5 Gb/s-PolSK-label, describe its bit-error-rate and spectral performance, and show that injection-locking may be used to demodulate and demultiplex the PolSK label

articleTitle: Using MCG to find PP-cycles in planar graphs [optical network applications]
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We present a detailed study on finding p-cycles. Called pp-cycles (planar p-cycles), they can take the geographical nature of the network into account and protect all links within the same area. An algorithm that exploits all these properties is implemented and tested.

articleTitle: Mitigation of PMD @ 40 Gb/s using an optically clocked 3R regenerator
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Mitigation of PMD distortions is performed at 40 Gb/s using a wavelength preserving semiconductor based all-optical 3R regenerator. The mitigation of PMD is successfully demonstrated by eye analysis and BER measurements for an average DGD of 10.2 ps.

articleTitle: Optimized planar photonic crystal waveguide 60/spl deg/ bend with more than 200 nm wide 1-dB transmission bandwidth
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Topology optimization was used to design a planar photonic crystal waveguide 60/spl deg/ bend leading to a record-breaking transmission bandwidth of more than 200 nm. The experimental results agree well with 3D finite-difference-time-domain simulations.

articleTitle: AWG misalignment tolerance of 16 /spl times/ 155 Mb/s WDM-PON based on ASE-injected FP-LDs
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Crosstalk penalties from adjacent and nonadjacent channels are experimentally analysed as a function of wavelength misalignment between AWGs at remote node and central office in a 16/spl times/155 Mb/s WDM-PON based on ASE-injected FP-LDs.

articleTitle: Impact of pump-phase modulation on the performance of dual-pump fiber-optic parametric amplifiers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We show that modulation of pump phases in dual-pump fiber-optic parametric amplifiers produces large signal fluctuations because of fiber dispersion. The performance becomes worse when the phase is modulated using pseudorandom bit patterns with a sharp rise time.

articleTitle: Investigation of electrical noise figure for fiber optical parametric amplifiers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Electrical measurements of the noise figure of a fiber optical parametric amplifier are presented and compared with optical measurements. The transfer of pump noise by four-wave mixing was clearly demonstrated.

articleTitle: 40Gbps operation of an offset quantum well active region based widely-tunable all-optical wavelength converter
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We demonstrate for the first time 40 Gbit/s operation of a quantum well based monolithically integrated widely tunable all-optical wavelength converter. We show open eyes at 40 Gbit/s RZ with an output switching window of 6 ps and low pattern dependence across a 25 nm output tuning.

articleTitle: A 40 Gb/s in-line co-packaged driver-modulator
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We fabricated a 40 Gb/s in-line co-packaged GaAs driver LiNbO/sub 3/ modulator. 40 Gb/s optical eye-diagrams obtained with this compact module show openings of 75% and 78% with RMS jitter lower than 1ps.

articleTitle: Catastrophic damage and destructive process induced in optical fiber cord by 33 dBm pump light at 1480 nm in WDM systems
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: This paper describes the catastrophic damage and destructive process induced in a bent optical fiber cord by a 33-dBm high power pump light in the 1480 nm in WDM transmission systems with a distributed Raman amplifier.

articleTitle: Ultimate performance and limitations of optical PMD compensators controlled by a spectrum monitor
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: The suitability of a spectrum monitor for controlling an optical PMD (polarization mode dispersion) compensator is investigated. Both ideal and practical monitor implementations are considered and compared, and ultimate performance and limitations given.

articleTitle: VDSL transmission over Latin routed DWDM optical access networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We present a novel architecture for sub-carrier multiplexed VDSL transmission utilising cascaded arrayed-waveguide grating optical access network. In particular, triple play was achieved with both DMT and QAM based VDSL modems.

articleTitle: Wide temperature (-40/spl deg/C-95/spl deg/C) operation of uncooled 1610 nm DFB laser for CWDM application
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We demonstrated a wide temperature operation from -40/spl deg/C to 95/spl deg/C of an L-band DFB laser for the first time. The BER at 2.5 Gb/s was maintained without error floor over 120 km up to 95/spl deg/C.

articleTitle: Detailed comparison of cross-phase modulation efficiency in offset quantum well and centered quantum well intermixed monolithically integrated widely-tunable MZI-SOA wavelength converters
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We investigate experimentally the cross-phase modulation efficiencies of monolithic tunable all-optical wavelength converters in both offset quantum-well and centered quantum-well intermixed InP integration platforms. CQW exhibit 60% higher efficiency with full 180 degree phase change possible.

articleTitle: A variable gain optical amplifier for metro WDM networks with mixed span losses: a gain-clamped semiconductor optical amplifier combined with a Raman fiber amplifier
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: A variable-gain optical amplifier for metro-WDM networks of mixed span losses is demonstrated. It consists of low-gain Raman-fiber-amplifier and gain-clamped SOA. 16/spl times/10 Gb/s signals were successfully transmitted over 170 km (87dB) of mixed span losses under dynamic add/drops.

articleTitle: 10 Gb/s direct modulation of 40 nm tunable modulated-grating Y-branch laser
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: High speed properties of a directly modulated widely tunable MG-Y laser have been evaluated. Small signal response and 10 Gb/s NRZ modulation were performed within the 40 nm tuning range.

articleTitle: Wideband all order PMD compensation via pulse shaping
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate, for the first time to our knowledge, all order PMD compensation using spectral pulse shaping. Two programmable double-pass pulse shapers are used in series to correct distorted polarization and phase spectra independently.

articleTitle: La-codoped bismuth-based erbium-doped fiber ring laser with 106-nm tuning range
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: 106-nm wideband tunable fiber ring laser using 84.6-cm long La-codoped bismuth-based EDF is reported. The laser emits high output power with 35 dB extinction ratio and a second output emits lower power but exhibits 60 dB extinction ratio.

articleTitle: Tunable dispersion compensator with twin chirped fiber gratings for polarization mode dispersion and chromatic dispersion
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We have developed new tunable dispersion compensators with twin chirped fiber gratings for polarization mode dispersion (PMD) and chromatic dispersion (CD), simultaneously, and successfully demonstrated their ability to change differential group delay (DGD) and chromatic dispersion, independently. The tuning range for the DGD and CD are 150 ps and 200 ps/nm, respectively. The validity of this device for ultra high speed optical communication was confirmed by the simulations of 43 Gbit/s CS-RZ optical transmission.

articleTitle: Over 1000 channel, 6.25 GHz-spaced ultra-DWDM transmission with supercontinuum multi-carrier source
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Over 1000 channel, 6.25 GHz spaced ultra-DWDM transmission is achieved using a supercontinuum multi-carrier source. We also investigate the influence of four-wave-mixing that occurred in the ultra-DWDM transmission.

articleTitle: Highly efficient fused-type core-cladding mode coupler
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We demonstrate a novel fused-type mode-selective coupler that couples the LP/sub 13/ cladding mode in one fiber to the LP/sub 01/ core mode in another fiber around 1550 nm. Coupling efficiency of 70% was achieved.

articleTitle: Transparent Bi/sub 2/O/sub 3/-based nonlinear optical fiber with erbium doping
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: An erbium-doped Bi/sub 2/O/sub 3/-based nonlinear optical fiber is developed to reduce the propagation loss. The significantly enhanced four-wave-mixing and its wavelength dependence reveal that the propagation loss is completely compensated by the Er/sup 3+/ excitation.

articleTitle: Microcoil photonic resonator and waveguide
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: The principal electromagnetic properties of the recently invented optical fiber microcoil resonator, which is suggested as a basic functional element for the future microfiber-based photonics, are investigated theoretically.

articleTitle: All-fiber based linearly polarized single-mode ytterbium fiber laser with > 300 W output
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We demonstrate the first completely monolithic linearly-polarized (extinction 19 dB) fiber laser producing high power (306 W) diffraction-limited beam (M/sup 2//spl sim/1.1) with a stabilized, narrow-linewidth (0.57 nm) spectrum at 1086 nm. Laser design does not require any external polarizing components.

articleTitle: Experimental comparison of system penalties due to 1/sup st/ order and multi-order polarization mode dispersion
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Using vectorially resolved launch SOP, we show that high order PMD, present in real fibers, introduces a deterministic correction to the accepted first-order system penalty, and an additional uniformly distributed scatter, uncorrelated to the second order PMD vector.

articleTitle: 1310-nm to 1550-nm wavelength conversion by utilizing nonlinear polarization rotation in a semiconductor optical amplifier
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We demonstrate a novel all-optical 1310-nm to 1550-nm wavelength converter based on nonlinear polarization rotation in a single semiconductor optical amplifier. Error-free polarization insensitive 1310-nm to 1550-nm wavelength conversion is shown at 10-Gbit/s.

articleTitle: Correction of the repeatable errors in the fabrication of sampled Bragg gratings
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: The correction of the repeatable errors in the fabrication of sampled Bragg gratings is firstly demonstrated. Various filters with high performance could be fabricated by reconstruction-equivalent-chirp method and this correction technique.

articleTitle: Four-port optical-filter fabricated from tapered optical fiber
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a four-port optical filter fabricated from a tapered optical fiber. The device is fabricated from tapered fiber loops wrapped around a low index rod.

articleTitle: Multi-user, 10 Gb/s spectrally phase coded O-CDMA system: two implementations
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We have experimentally demonstrated 4-user, 10 Gbit/s spectrally phase coded O-CDMA using low power nonlinear processing in two implementations, with emphasis on different coding schemes and requirements of timing coordination.

articleTitle: A time-domain technique for measuring the complex PMD vector in systems with PMD and PDL
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Expressing the time-dependent output Stokes parameters in terms of the complex PMD vector, yields a novel time-domain measurement technique and gives insight to its relation to the temporal effects of PMD and PDL.

articleTitle: Passive optical networks for FTTx applications
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Applications of passive optical networks, especially WDM-PON, for FTTH and FTTPole are investigated. We also demonstrate a new WDM-PON based on wavelength locked FP-LDs to injected spectrum sliced narrow band ASE.

articleTitle: EDFAs with improved gain-flatness owing to a new pump design
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: A new pump source based on a semiconductor array coupled with an external cavity laser is shown. Its broad output spectrum allows to improve the EDFA gain flatness while reducing manufacturing cost.

articleTitle: Highly reliable and high yield 1300 nm InGaAlAs directly modulated ridge Fabry-Perot lasers, operating at 10 Gb/s, up to 110/spl deg/C, with constant current swing
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Transceivers for 300 m multimode links, based on a serial 10 Gb laser source and incorporating receiver based electronic dispersion compensation (EDC) are creating the first high volume application for 10 Gb FP (Fabry Perot). A highly reliable and high yield uncooled ridge FP laser is presented. The device shows excellent power characteristics in the 25-150/spl deg/C temperature range with very high T0 (95 K in the temperature range 0-85/spl deg/C and still 78 K at 150/spl deg/C). Outstanding dynamic performances are also shown: 6 dB of extinction ratio can be achieved up to 110/spl deg/C, by using a constant current swing of 50 mA.

articleTitle: 40-Gb/s RZ-DQPSK time-polarization interleaving
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Time-polarization interleaving 40-Gbit/s RZ-DQPSK with 100-ps symbol-slot is received with integrated equipment designed for 10-Gsymbol/s DPSK detection without polarization demultiplexing. BER comparison with other 40 Gbit/s equivalent modulation formats is experimentally investigated in back-to-back configuration.

articleTitle: DGE-based variable gain EDFA improves both gain flatness and noise figure for a 70/spl deg/C temperature operating range
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We designed a +17.5 dBm variable-gain EDFA (20 to 28 dB) incorporating a dynamic gain equalizer (DGE). Its noise figure is maintained below 5.2 dB and its gain flatness is better than 1 dB when operating from -5 to +65/spl deg/C.

articleTitle: Bi-directional higher-order Raman pumping for improved performances in long-span 10 Gbit/s WDM unrepeated transmission systems
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Benefits provided by higher-order bi-directional Raman pumping schemes in 10 Gbit/s unrepeated WDM transmission systems are experimentally investigated. As confirmed by calculations, the unrepeated system reach enhancement is mainly limited by pump-to-signal RIN transfer induced by higher-order co-pumping.

articleTitle: Direct modeling of error statistics at 40 Gbit/s rate in SMF/DCF link with strong bit overlapping
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Through extensive direct modeling we determine exponential tails of the probability density functions for marks/spaces and quantify patterning effect in the error statistics for SMF/DCF transmission at 40 Gbit/s. Simple derived analytical approximations for the PDF tails enable us to accurately predict the error rate.

articleTitle: Design and fabrication of a micro-cavity laser with transparent micro loop mirror
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We describe a linear laser with micro loops as end mirrors. FDTD simulation is used to design the mirror and laser cavity. The initial fabrication results with a lasing threshold of /spl sim/0.4 mA is presented.

articleTitle: Extremely low-power intensity autocorrelation and chromatic dispersion monitoring for 10-GHz, 3-ps optical pulses by aperiodically poled lithium niobate (A-PPLN) waveguide
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We demonstrate intensity autocorrelation of 10-GHz, 3-ps pulses at 43 dBm average input power with an A-PPLN waveguide. Chromatic dispersion monitoring at -45 dBm and 100-ms sampling time is also demonstrated.

articleTitle: A ternary modulation code for suppression of intrachannel nonlinear effects in high-speed optical transmission
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: The paper proposes a novel approach to suppressing intrachannel nonlinear effects; it is based on ternary modulation codes. Significant Q-factor improvement, ranging from 4.5 to 7 dB (depending on number of spans), is obtained.

articleTitle: Information capacity of nonlinear fiber-optical systems
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We develop information-theoretical description of nonlinear optical communication systems. We present a non-perturbative calculation of the information capacity for different modulation formats, and demonstrate that fiber nonlinearity leads to exponential suppression of the channel capacity.

articleTitle: Label erasure using an imbalanced NOLM and its application in a 40Gbit/s label switching optical network
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: A novel and simple scheme based on the nonlinear transmission function of an imbalanced nonlinear optical loop mirror is used to realize label erasure. The scheme has been successfully applied in a 40 Gbit/s label switching optical network with 200 km transmission distance.

articleTitle: Improvement of DPSK transmission by using convolutional error correction coding
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We quantify the improvement in the transmission quality for DPSK transmission by using convolutional error correction coding. To avoid bandwidth-limitation problems from, e.g., chromatic dispersion, the convolutional coding is combined with bandwidth efficient modulation. The modulation schemes used are return-to-zero differential quadrature phase shift keying (RZ-DQPSK) and RZ-ASK/DSPK modulation which is a combination of amplitude shift keying (ASK) and differential phase shift keying (DPSK). For uncoded transmission, RZ-DPSK modulation is used as a benchmark. The RZ-DQPSK transmission scheme offers a clearly better coding gain than the RZ-ASK/DPSK scheme.

articleTitle: Comparison and assessment of different polarization mode dispersion models
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We compare first-, second- and all-order PMD models for systems with and without first-order PMD compensation. Often the first- and second-order PMD models fail by overestimating PMD distortions, especially when the PMD is large.

articleTitle: Label swapping for DPSK encoded labels without wavelength conversion
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We demonstrate label swapping for DPSK encoded labels using synchronous phase modulation (SPM). For the first time label erasure and insertion is performed in a single step without a need for wavelength conversion.

articleTitle: All-optical label erasure/recognition of novel DPSK optical packets for optical packet switching
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We demonstrate all-optical label erasure/recognition of novel DPSK optical packets by using an all-optical label pre-processor and all-optical correlators. Experimental results show low power and asynchronous label erasure/recognition operation on two labels at 12.5 Gbit/s.

articleTitle: Waveguide mode conversion using anti-symmetric gratings
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Many important optical devices based on grating mode converters require special designs to mitigate the effect of undesired reflections. We propose a simple and novel grating mode converter which avoids undesired multiple reflection peaks.

articleTitle: Generalized low-density parity-check codes for long-haul high-speed optical communications
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: In this paper, the BER performance of GLDPC codes, outperforming currently known turbo and LDPC coding schemes utilized in optical communication systems, is analyzed. The largest so far reported coding gain of at least 11 dB (at 40 Gb/s with 23.6% of redundancy) is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Novel wide-band low-PDL integrated variable optical attenuator in silica-on-silicon
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We present a novel wide band VOA with low PDL. Our device is a symmetric MZI-based PLC component that uses y-junctions and adiabatic couplers. We describe a model that explains PDL for this VOA and enables polarization control.

articleTitle: World's first 40 Gbps overlay on a field-deployed, 10 Gbps, mixed-fiber, 1200 km, ultra long-haul system
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: MCI, Ciena, and Mintera successfully demonstrated the capability of overlaying a production quality 40 Gbps CS-RZ optical signal on a Ciena-designed 1200 km ultra long-haul (ULH) system over an MCI multi-span, mixed-field fiber route from Sacramento to Salt Lake City.

articleTitle: Time division add-drop multiplexing up to 320 Gbit/s
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: We report an all-optical add-drop multiplexer based on a Kerr-gate comprising highly nonlinear fiber. Error-free operation is obtained for all channels at 160 Gbit/s. The device can operate up to 320 Gbit/s, which is demonstrated by eye diagram measurements.

articleTitle: High-speed CPFSK WDM signal transmission using PLC-LN hybrid asymmetric MZ modulator
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
abstract: Novel frequency shift keying (FSK) transmitter is proposed for high-speed modulation. We demonstrate 43-Gbit/s continuous-phase FSK signal transmission, for the first time, in 4-ch WDM experiment using novel PLC-LN hybrid modulator and balanced detection.

articleTitle: The demonstration of congestion-controlled optical burst switching network utilizing two-way signaling - field trial in JGN II testbed
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC Technical Digest. Optical Fiber Communication Conference, 2005.
